name.en: the old ways of the peoples

origin.ja: 南陽宛の人。家はもと屠畜を業とした。異母妹が後宮に入って[[p:霊帝]]の皇后となり、その縁で取り立てられた。
origin.en: A man of Wan in Nanyang, of a family of butchers. His half-sister entered the palace and became empress to [[p:霊帝|Emperor Ling]], and he rose through her.

origin.ja: 安定朝那の人。度遼将軍皇甫規の兄の子で、代々の武門の出。
origin.en: A man of Chaona in Anding, nephew of the frontier general Huangfu Gui — of a line of soldiers.

origin.ja: 会稽上虞の人。幼くして父を失い、母が絹を売って暮らしを立てた。孝行と義侠で郷里に知られた。
origin.en: A man of Shangyu in Kuaiji. His father died when he was small and his mother lived by selling silk; he was known at home for filial piety and generosity.

origin.ja: 涿郡涿の人。若いころ鄭玄とともに馬融に学んだ。郷里で教えた弟子に[[p:劉備]]と[[p:公孫瓚]]がいる。
origin.en: A man of Zhuo. In his youth he studied under Ma Rong alongside Zheng Xuan. Among the pupils he taught at home were [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] and [[p:公孫瓚|Gongsun Zan]].

origin.ja: 隴西臨洮の人。若いころ羌の地を巡って羌の首領たちと交わった。腕力に優れ、馬を走らせながら左右どちらにも弓を射た。
origin.en: A man of Lintao in Longxi. In his youth he roamed the Qiang lands and made friends of their chiefs. Very strong, he could shoot to either side from a galloping horse.

origin.ja: 太原祁の人。代々州郡の高官を出した家。同郡の名士郭泰に「王佐の才」と評された。
origin.en: A man of Qi in Taiyuan, of a family that had held provincial and commandery office for generations. The local worthy Guo Tai called him "a talent fit to aid a king".

origin.ja: 鉅鹿の人。太平道を開いた張角の弟。
origin.en: A man of Julu, younger brother of Zhang Jue, founder of the Way of Great Peace.

origin.ja: 鉅鹿の人。太平道を開いた張角の弟。
origin.en: A man of Julu, younger brother of Zhang Jue, founder of the Way of Great Peace.

origin.ja: 魯国の人で、孔子の二十世の孫。十歳のとき名士李膺の門を訪ね、孔子と老子の古い縁を持ち出して通され、才を驚かせた。
origin.en: A man of Lu, twentieth-generation descendant of Confucius. At ten he called on the great Li Ying, got past the gate by citing the old bond between Confucius and Laozi, and astonished all with his wit.

origin.ja: 沛国譙の人。徐州に遊学して数種の経書に通じた。孝廉に挙げられ、太尉にも招かれたが、どちらも応じなかった。
origin.en: A man of Qiao in Pei. He studied in Xu province and mastered several classics. Recommended as filial and incorrupt, and summoned by the grand commandant, he declined both.

origin.ja: 陳留圉の人で、学者蔡邕の娘。最初の夫に死別して実家に戻ったのち、乱の中で匈奴に連れ去られ、十二年後に[[p:曹操]]が身代金を払って連れ戻した。
origin.en: A woman of Yu in Chenliu, daughter of the scholar Cai Yong. Widowed and back home, she was carried off by the Xiongnu in the chaos; twelve years later [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] ransomed her back.

origin.ja: 潁川潁陰の人。祖父荀淑は名士で、その八人の子は「八龍」と呼ばれた。若いころ何顒に「王佐の才」と評された。初め[[p:袁紹]]に身を寄せたが、去って[[p:曹操]]に仕えた。
origin.en: A man of Yingyin in Yingchuan. His grandfather Xun Shu was a noted worthy whose eight sons were called "the Eight Dragons". He Yong called him "a talent fit to aid a king". He went first to [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]], then left him for [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]].

origin.ja: 潁川潁陰の人で、[[p:荀彧]]の一族の甥 (年は荀彧より上)。何進に召されて朝廷に仕え、董卓の暗殺を謀って獄に下された。
origin.en: A man of Yingyin in Yingchuan, a clan nephew of [[p:荀彧|Xun Yu]] (though older than he). Summoned to court by He Jin, he plotted to kill Dong Zhuo and was thrown into prison.

origin.ja: 潁川陽翟の人。初め北へ行って[[p:袁紹]]に会ったが、大事を成せる人ではないと見て去った。[[p:荀彧]]の推薦で[[p:曹操]]に仕えた。
origin.en: A man of Yangzhai in Yingchuan. He went north to see [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]], judged him unable to achieve great things, and left. On [[p:荀彧|Xun Yu]]'s recommendation he served [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]].

origin.ja: 東郡東阿の人。黄巾が起きると県の人々をまとめて城を守った。もとの名は程立で、泰山で日を捧げる夢を見たため、[[p:曹操]]が「日」を加えて「昱」と改めさせたと伝わる。
origin.en: A man of Dong'e in Dong commandery. When the Yellow Turbans rose he rallied his county to hold its walls. He is said to have first been named Cheng Li, and to have dreamt of holding up the sun on Mount Tai, so [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] added "sun" to his name, making it Yu.

origin.ja: 武威姑臧の人。若いころ漢陽の閻忠に「張良・陳平の才」と評された。病で郷里へ帰る途中で氐に捕らわれたが、太尉段熲の外孫と偽って一人だけ助かった。
origin.en: A man of Guzang in Wuwei. Yan Zhong of Hanyang said he had the gifts of Zhang Liang and Chen Ping. Captured by the Di on his way home sick, he alone was spared by claiming to be a grandson of the grand commandant Duan Jiong.

origin.ja: 沛国譙の人。漢の高祖に仕えた夏侯嬰の子孫。十四歳のとき、師を辱めた者を殺して烈しい気性で知られた。
origin.en: A man of Qiao in Pei, descendant of Xiahou Ying, who served the founder of Han. At fourteen he killed a man who had insulted his teacher, and was known for his fierce spirit.

origin.ja: 沛国譙の人で、[[p:夏侯惇]]の一族の弟。郷里で罪を得た曹操の身代わりとなって罪をかぶったことがある。
origin.en: A man of Qiao in Pei, a younger kinsman of [[p:夏侯惇|Xiahou Dun]]. Once, when Cao Cao was charged with a crime at home, he took the blame in his place.

origin.ja: 沛国譙の人で、曹操の従弟。若いころは弓馬と狩猟を好み、天下が乱れると千人余りを集めて曹操に従った。
origin.en: A man of Qiao in Pei, Cao Cao's cousin. In his youth he loved riding, archery and the hunt; when the realm fell into disorder he gathered a thousand men and followed Cao Cao.

origin.ja: 陳留己吾の人。体が大きく力が強く、友のために仇を討って名を知られた。
origin.en: A man of Jiwu in Chenliu, huge and strong, who made his name avenging a friend.

origin.ja: 譙国譙の人。漢の末に一族数千家を集めて砦を築き、汝南の葛陂の賊を防いだ。食糧と引き換えに賊へ渡した牛が逃げ戻ったとき、その尾をつかんで百歩余り引きずり、賊を驚かせたという。
origin.en: A man of Qiao. At the end of Han he gathered thousands of families of his clan behind a stockade and held off the Gepi bandits of Runan; once, when an ox traded to them for food ran back, he dragged it a hundred paces by its tail, to their terror.

origin.ja: 雁門馬邑の人。前漢の聶壱の子孫で、仇を避けて姓を張に改めた家。并州の丁原・董卓・呂布に仕え、のち曹操に降った。
origin.en: A man of Mayi in Yanmen, of the line of Nie Yi of Former Han; the family took the name Zhang to escape a vendetta. He served Ding Yuan, Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu before surrendering to Cao Cao.

origin.ja: 河東楊の人。郡の役人から楊奉に従い、献帝の東帰を守った。のち楊奉を離れて曹操に仕えた。
origin.en: A man of Yang in Hedong. A commandery clerk, he followed Yang Feng and guarded Emperor Xian on his way east, then left Yang Feng to serve Cao Cao.

origin.ja: 河間鄚の人。黄巾討伐の募兵に応じて韓馥に、ついで袁紹に仕えた。官渡の戦いのさなかに曹操に降った。
origin.en: A man of Mao in Hejian. He answered the call to fight the Yellow Turbans, served Han Fu and then Yuan Shao, and went over to Cao Cao in the midst of Guandu.

origin.ja: 泰山鉅平の人。鮑信の募兵に従い、のち曹操の下で頭角を現した。
origin.en: A man of Juping in Taishan. He joined Bao Xin's levy and rose under Cao Cao.

origin.ja: 陽平衛国の人。小柄だが胆力があり、帳下の吏から曹操に従った。
origin.en: A man of Weiguo in Yangping, small but bold; he followed Cao Cao from a clerk of his staff.

origin.ja: 河内温の人。代々高官を出した家で、父の司馬防は京兆尹。[[p:曹操]]の最初の召しを病と称して断ったと伝わる。
origin.en: A man of Wen in Henei, of a family of high officials; his father Sima Fang was governor of the capital district. He is said to have refused [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]]'s first summons by feigning illness.

origin.ja: [[p:曹操]]と[[p:卞夫人]]の子で、[[p:曹丕]]の同母弟。十歳余りで詩や論・辞賦を数十万言そらんじ、文章に巧みだった。
origin.en: Son of [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] and [[p:卞夫人|Lady Bian]], full brother of [[p:曹丕|Cao Pi]]. Past ten he could recite hundreds of thousands of words of poems, essays and rhapsodies, and wrote with great skill.

origin.ja: 曹操の一族の子。父が曹操のために兵を集めて討たれたため、曹操に引き取られ、[[p:曹丕]]とともに実の子同様に育てられた。
origin.en: A child of Cao Cao's clan. His father was killed raising troops for Cao Cao, who took him in and raised him as his own, alongside [[p:曹丕|Cao Pi]].

origin.ja: 潁川許の人。祖父の陳寔、父の陳紀はともに名高い名士。幼いころ祖父に「この子は必ず我が一族を興す」と言われた。豫州の[[p:劉備]]に仕えたのち[[p:曹操]]に仕えた。
origin.en: A man of Xu in Yingchuan; his grandfather Chen Shi and father Chen Ji were famous worthies. As a boy his grandfather said "this child will raise our house". He served [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] in Yu province, then [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]].

origin.ja: 潁川長社の人。孝廉に挙げられ、長安で[[p:献帝]]に仕えて帝の東への脱出を助けた。のちの世に書の名手とたたえられた。子に[[p:鍾会]]がいる。
origin.en: A man of Changshe in Yingchuan. Recommended as filial and incorrupt, he served [[p:献帝|Emperor Xian]] at Chang'an and helped him escape east. Later ages hailed him as a master calligrapher. His son was [[p:鍾会|Zhong Hui]].

origin.ja: 山陽昌邑の人。十八歳で郡の督郵となり、法を曲げない役人として知られた。
origin.en: A man of Changyi in Shanyang. At eighteen he was a commandery inspector, known as an official who would not bend the law.

origin.ja: 太原の人。若くして軍に入り、河西を十年余り守ったと伝わる。
origin.en: A man of Taiyuan who, it is said, joined the army young and held the Hexi frontier for over ten years.

origin.ja: 義陽棘陽の人。幼くして父を失い、牛飼いをしながら育った。吃音があったが、高い山や広い沢を見るたびに陣を敷く場所を測ったという。
origin.en: A man of Jiyang in Yiyang. Fatherless from childhood, he grew up herding cattle. He stammered, but whenever he saw high hills and broad marshes, they say, he worked out where to pitch a camp.

origin.ja: 潁川長社の人で、太傅鍾繇の末の子。幼いころから聡明で知られた。
origin.en: A man of Changshe in Yingchuan, youngest son of the grand tutor Zhong Yao, known as brilliant from childhood.

origin.ja: [[p:司馬懿]]の長男。若いころから評判が高く、夏侯玄・何晏と並び称されたと伝わる。
origin.en: Eldest son of [[p:司馬懿|Sima Yi]]. He is said to have been praised from youth and ranked with Xiahou Xuan and He Yan.

origin.ja: [[p:司馬懿]]の次男で、[[p:司馬師]]の同母弟。
origin.en: Second son of [[p:司馬懿|Sima Yi]], full brother of [[p:司馬師|Sima Shi]].

origin.ja: 泰山南城の人。九代にわたって二千石の高官を出した家で、母は蔡邕の娘、姉は司馬師の妻。
origin.en: A man of Nancheng in Taishan, of a family that had given high officials for nine generations; his mother was Cai Yong's daughter, his sister the wife of Sima Shi.

origin.ja: 京兆杜陵の人。祖父の杜畿は魏の重臣で、妻は司馬懿の娘。『春秋左氏伝』を深く愛し、自ら「左伝癖」と言った。
origin.en: A man of Duling near the capital. His grandfather Du Ji was a great minister of Wei, his wife a daughter of Sima Yi. He loved the Zuozhuan so much that he called it his "Zuozhuan addiction".

origin.ja: 譙国銍の人。先祖は会稽から移り住み、そのとき姓を嵆に改めたという。魏の宗室の娘を妻とし、河内の山陽に住んで[[p:阮籍]]らと交わったと伝わる。
origin.en: A man of Zhi in Qiao. His forebears are said to have moved there from Kuaiji and taken the name Ji; he is also said to have married a lady of the Wei imperial clan, lived at Shanyang in Henei, and kept company with [[p:阮籍|Ruan Ji]] and others.

origin.ja: 陳留尉氏の人。父は建安の文人阮瑀。礼法にこだわる人を嫌い、気に入らない相手には白い目を向けたと伝わる。
origin.en: A man of Weishi in Chenliu; his father was Ruan Yu, a writer of the Jian'an age. He disliked sticklers for ritual and, it is said, met those he disdained with the whites of his eyes.

origin.ja: 平原の人。容貌は粗野で酒を好んだ。幼いころから星空を見上げるのを好み、夜も眠らなかったと伝わる。
origin.en: A man of Pingyuan, rough-looking and fond of wine. As a child, it is said, he loved to gaze at the stars and would not sleep at night.

origin.ja: 鉅鹿の人。正直さゆえ韓馥に用いられなかった。博学で茂才に挙げられ侍御史となったが、宦官の専横に官を捨てて帰郷し、[[p:袁紹]]が礼を尽くして招いたと伝わる (渤海の人とも)。
origin.en: A man of Julu; his uprightness kept him out of favour with Han Fu. Learned, he is said to have been recommended as "flourishing talent" and made attendant censor, to have quit in disgust at the eunuchs, and to have been invited by [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]] with every courtesy (some say he was from Bohai).

origin.ja: 広平の人で、若くして大志があり、冀州牧韓馥の別駕を務めたと伝わる。韓馥の騎都尉だったが、韓馥が冀州を[[p:袁紹]]に譲ると袁紹に仕えた。
origin.en: Said to have been a man of Guangping, ambitious from youth, and lieutenant to Han Fu, governor of Ji province. He was Han Fu's cavalry commandant, and served [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]] once Han Fu yielded the province to him.

origin.ja: 魏郡の人。若くして忠烈で、犯しがたい節操があったと伝わる。韓馥には用いられず、[[p:袁紹]]に仕えた。
origin.en: A man of Wei commandery, said to have been loyal and fiery from youth, of unbending principle. Unused by Han Fu, he served [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]].

origin.ja: 出自は記録に無い。袁紹の将で、[[p:文醜]]とともに名将と呼ばれた。白馬で[[p:関羽]]に討たれた。
origin.en: Their origins are not on record. A general of Yuan Shao, named with [[p:文醜|Wen Chou]] as his finest; [[p:関羽|Guan Yu]] cut him down at Baima.

origin.ja: 出自は記録に無い。袁紹の将で、[[p:顔良]]とともに名将と呼ばれた。延津の南で曹操の軍に討たれた。
origin.en: Their origins are not on record. A general of Yuan Shao, named with [[p:顔良|Yan Liang]] as his finest; he was killed by Cao Cao's army south of Yanjin.

origin.ja: 東郡の人で、剛直な気性で、若くして各地の名士と交わったと伝わる。初め[[p:曹操]]に従ったが、194年に張邈とともに背き、[[p:呂布]]を兗州に迎えた。
origin.en: Said to have been a man of Dong commandery, upright, and to have known the worthies of the realm when young. He first followed [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]], but in 194 turned on him with Zhang Miao and brought [[p:呂布|Lü Bu]] into Yan province.

origin.ja: 出自は記録に無い。呂布の将で、下邳で呂布とともに斬られた。裴松之注の『英雄記』には、清廉で威厳があり酒も贈り物も受けず、率いる七百余の兵は「陥陳営」と呼ばれたと伝わる。
origin.en: Their origins are not on record. A general of Lü Bu, beheaded with him at Xiapi. The Yingxiong ji (in Pei Songzhi's notes) says he was upright and stern, drank no wine and took no gifts, and that his seven hundred men were called "the camp that breaks the line".

origin.ja: 右北平無終の人。書を好み撃剣に優れた。幽州牧劉虞の使者として長安へ赴き、戻ると劉虞は[[p:公孫瓚]]に殺されていたため、一族を率いて徐無山にこもった。
origin.en: A man of Wuzhong in Youbeiping, a lover of books and a fine swordsman. He went to Chang'an as envoy of Liu Yu, governor of You; finding on his return that [[p:公孫瓚|Gongsun Zan]] had killed Liu Yu, he led his clan into the Xuwu hills.

origin.ja: 河東解の人。郷里を出て涿郡へ逃れ、そこで兵を集めていた[[p:劉備]]に従った。[[p:張飛]]とともに、劉備とは寝床を同じくするほどの間柄だった。
origin.en: A man of Xie in Hedong. He fled his home to Zhuo, where he joined [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]], then raising men; he and [[p:張飛|Zhang Fei]] were so close to Liu Bei that they shared his bed.

origin.ja: 涿郡の人。若いころから[[p:関羽]]とともに[[p:劉備]]に仕え、関羽を兄として敬った。
origin.en: A man of Zhuo. From his youth he served [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] with [[p:関羽|Guan Yu]], whom he honoured as an elder brother.

origin.ja: 常山真定の人。公孫瓚に属し、そこで[[p:劉備]]と出会った。郷里の義勇兵を率いて公孫瓚のもとへ行ったと伝わる。
origin.en: A man of Zhending in Changshan. He served under Gongsun Zan, where he met [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]]; he is said to have brought his home district's volunteers there.

origin.ja: 琅邪陽都の人。前漢の司隷校尉諸葛豊の子孫。早く父を失い、叔父に従って荊州へ移った。南陽で自ら耕しながら、自分を管仲・楽毅に比した。兄に[[p:諸葛瑾]]。
origin.en: A man of Yangdu in Langya, descendant of Zhuge Feng, a Former Han inspector of the capital. Orphaned early, he went with his uncle to Jing. Farming in Nanyang, he likened himself to Guan Zhong and Yue Yi. His elder brother was [[p:諸葛瑾|Zhuge Jin]].

origin.ja: 襄陽の人。若いころは地味で目立たなかったが、[[p:司馬徽]]を訪ね、桑の木の上と下で昼から夜まで語り合って認められた。
origin.en: A man of Xiangyang, plain and unremarkable in youth. He called on [[p:司馬徽|Sima Hui]], and the two talked from noon into the night, Sima Hui up a mulberry tree and he beneath it, until he won his esteem.

origin.ja: 扶風郿の人。祖父の法真は清廉で名高い。飢饉のとき同郡の[[p:孟達]]とともに蜀へ入って[[p:劉璋]]に仕えたが、重く用いられなかった。
origin.en: A man of Mei in Fufeng; his grandfather Fa Zhen was famed for integrity. In a famine he went to Shu with [[p:孟達|Meng Da]] of the same commandery and served [[p:劉璋|Liu Zhang]], who made little use of him.

origin.ja: 南陽の人。劉表に仕えて長沙を守り、劉備が荊州南部を取ると従った。
origin.en: A man of Nanyang. He served Liu Biao, guarding Changsha, and joined Liu Bei when Liu Bei took southern Jing.

origin.ja: 義陽の人。私兵の頭として劉備に従い、蜀へ入った。
origin.en: A man of Yiyang. He followed Liu Bei into Shu at the head of his own retainers.

origin.ja: 襄陽宜城の人。兄弟五人がみな才名高く、眉に白い毛があった馬良が最も優れ、「馬氏の五常、白眉最も良し」と言われた。弟に[[p:馬謖]]。
origin.en: A man of Yicheng in Xiangyang. All five brothers were famed for talent, and he, who had white hairs in his brows, was the best: "Of the five Ma, White Brows is best." His younger brother was [[p:馬謖|Ma Su]].

origin.ja: 襄陽宜城の人で、馬良の弟。兄弟五人がみな才名高く、「馬氏の五常、白眉最も良し」と言われた (白眉は眉に白い毛のある兄の馬良)。
origin.en: A man of Yicheng in Xiangyang, younger brother of Ma Liang. All five brothers were famed for talent: "Of the five Ma, White Brows is best" (White Brows being Ma Liang).

origin.ja: 零陵湘郷の人。若くして母方のいとこ劉敏とともに名を知られた。書佐として[[p:劉備]]に従い蜀に入った。
origin.en: A man of Xiangxiang in Lingling, known young together with his maternal cousin Liu Min. He followed [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] into Shu as a clerk.

origin.ja: 江夏鄳の人。幼くして父を失い、一族の費伯仁を頼った。伯仁の叔母が[[p:劉璋]]の母だった縁で、伯仁に連れられて蜀に入った。
origin.en: A man of Meng in Jiangxia. Orphaned young, he lived with his kinsman Fei Boren, whose aunt was the mother of [[p:劉璋|Liu Zhang]]; so Boren took him into Shu.

origin.ja: 天水冀の人。父は郡の役人で、羌の反乱で郡の長官をかばって戦死した。魏の天水郡に仕えていたが、諸葛亮の北伐のさなかに蜀に降った。
origin.en: A man of Ji in Tianshui. His father, a commandery officer, died shielding the governor in a Qiang rising. He was serving Wei's Tianshui when he went over to Shu during Zhuge Liang's northern campaign.

origin.ja: 巴西閬中の人。郡の吏から[[p:劉璋]]の主簿となり、[[p:劉備]]を蜀に迎えることに反対した。
origin.en: A man of Langzhong in Baxi. From a commandery clerk he became [[p:劉璋|Liu Zhang]]'s registrar, and argued against inviting [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] into Shu.

origin.ja: 巴西西充国の人。幼くして父を失い、母と兄と暮らした。古典を好み、家の貧しさを気にかけず学んだ。
origin.en: A man of Xichongguo in Baxi. Orphaned young, he lived with his mother and elder brother, loved the classics, and studied heedless of his family's poverty.

origin.ja: 右北平土垠の人。州郡の役人から孫堅に従い、孫氏三代に仕えた最古参。
origin.en: A man of Tuyin in Youbeiping. From a provincial clerk he followed Sun Jian and served three generations of the Sun — the eldest of their veterans.

origin.ja: 零陵泉陵の人。南陽太守黄子廉の子孫で、幼くして父を失い、薪を担いで暮らしながら学問と兵法を学んだと伝わる。
origin.en: A man of Quanling in Lingling, said to descend from Huang Zilian, governor of Nanyang; orphaned as a boy, he is said to have carried firewood for a living while he studied letters and war.

origin.ja: 廬江舒の人。従祖父の周景とその子の周忠が漢の太尉を務めた名家の出。孫策と同い年で、屋敷を譲って住まわせるほどの親友だった。
origin.en: A man of Shu in Lujiang, of a great family: his grand-uncle Zhou Jing and Zhou Jing's son Zhou Zhong had been grand commandants of Han. The same age as Sun Ce, he was such a friend that he gave him a house to live in.

origin.ja: 彭城の人。若くして学問を好み、隷書に巧みだった。徐州の乱を避けて長江を渡り、[[p:孫策]]に仕えて長史となった。
origin.en: A man of Pengcheng, studious from youth and skilled in clerical script. Fleeing the troubles of Xu province across the Yangzi, he served [[p:孫策|Sun Ce]] as chief clerk.

origin.ja: 東莱黄の人。郡の役人だったとき、州の上奏文を役人から騙し取って破り、郡の上奏を先に届けて名を上げた。
origin.en: A man of Huang in Donglai. As a commandery clerk he tricked the province's envoy into handing over its memorial, tore it up and got his own commandery's in first — and made his name.

origin.ja: 臨淮東城の人。生まれてすぐ父を失い、祖母に育てられた。家は豊かで、財を散じて人と交わった。[[p:周瑜]]が食糧を求めると、二つあった米倉の一つをそのまま与えた。
origin.en: A man of Dongcheng in Linhuai. Fatherless at birth, he was raised by his grandmother. Rich, he spent freely to make friends; when [[p:周瑜|Zhou Yu]] asked for food he gave him one of his two granaries outright.

origin.ja: 巴郡臨江の人。若いころは無頼の若者を率い、腰に鈴を下げて人々に知られた。舟を錦でつなぐほど派手だったと伝わる。のち劉表・黄祖を経て孫権に仕えた。
origin.en: A man of Linjiang in Ba. In his youth he led a band of wild young men with bells at their belts; he is said to have moored his boats with brocade. He served Liu Biao and Huang Zu before Sun Quan.

origin.ja: 汝南富陂の人。姉の夫の鄧当に従って孫策の軍に入った。学問がなかったが、孫権に勧められて学び、のちに魯粛から「もはや呉下の阿蒙ではない」と言われたと伝わる。
origin.en: A man of Fupi in Runan. He joined Sun Ce's army following his sister's husband Deng Dang. Unlettered, he studied at Sun Quan's urging, and Lu Su is said to have told him "you are no longer the Ameng of Wu".

origin.ja: 呉郡呉の人。江東の名家陸氏の出で、孫策に攻められ、一族百人余りの半ば近くを失った陸康の一族。のち孫策の娘を妻とした。
origin.en: A man of Wu, of the great Lu family of Jiangdong — kin of Lu Kang, nearly half of whose clan of a hundred died when Sun Ce attacked him. He later married Sun Ce's daughter.

origin.ja: 琅邪陽都の人で、[[p:諸葛亮]]の兄。若いころ都に遊学したと伝わる。乱を避けて江東へ移り、[[p:孫策]]の死後、[[p:孫権]]に仕えた。
origin.en: A man of Yangdu in Langya, elder brother of [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]]. He is said to have studied at the capital in youth. He fled the troubles to Jiangdong, and after [[p:孫策|Sun Ce]] died served [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]].

origin.ja: [[p:孫堅]]の娘で[[p:孫権]]の妹。史書では「孫夫人」とだけ記される。兄たちに似て才気鋭く剛猛で、侍女百人余りがみな刀を持って仕えていた。
origin.en: Daughter of [[p:孫堅|Sun Jian]] and sister of [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]]; the histories call her only "Lady Sun". Quick and fierce like her brothers, she kept over a hundred maids who all stood by her with swords.

origin.ja: [[p:陸遜]]の子で、母は孫策の娘。
origin.en: Son of [[p:陸遜|Lu Xun]]; his mother was Sun Ce's daughter.

origin.ja: 廬江安豊の人。若くして勇猛で知られ、甘寧・陸遜・潘璋の下で戦った。
origin.en: A man of Anfeng in Lujiang, known young for his courage; he fought under Gan Ning, Lu Xun and Pan Zhang.

origin.ja: 会稽余姚の人。代々『易』を伝える家だったと伝わる。会稽太守王朗の功曹を務め、のち[[p:孫策]]に仕えた。
origin.en: A man of Yuyao in Kuaiji, said to come of a family that handed down the Book of Changes. He was an officer of Wang Lang, governor of Kuaiji, and later served [[p:孫策|Sun Ce]].

origin.ja: 扶風の人。劉璋に仕え、法正とともに劉備を蜀に迎えた。
origin.en: A man of Fufeng. He served Liu Zhang and, with Fa Zheng, brought Liu Bei into Shu.

origin.ja: 南安狟道の人。郡の役人から馬騰・馬超に従った。
origin.en: A man of Huandao in Nan'an; from a commandery clerk he followed Ma Teng and Ma Chao.

origin.ja: 馬超の従弟。
origin.en: Cousin of Ma Chao.

origin.ja: 蒼梧広信の人。先祖は魯国の人で、王莽の乱を避けて交州へ移った。父は日南太守。若いころ洛陽で『春秋左氏伝』を学んだ。
origin.en: A man of Guangxin in Cangwu. His forebears came from Lu and moved to Jiao province to escape the troubles of Wang Mang; his father was governor of Rinan. In youth he studied the Zuozhuan at Luoyang.

origin.ja: 潁川の人。若いころは任侠を好み、人の仇を討って捕らえられたが仲間に救われ、以後学問に励んだと伝わる。[[p:諸葛亮]]の友で、母が[[p:曹操]]に捕らわれたため[[p:劉備]]のもとを去った。
origin.en: A man of Yingchuan. He is said to have been a swordsman in youth, caught after avenging a wrong done to another and freed by comrades, then turned to study. A friend of [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]], he left [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] when [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] seized his mother.

origin.ja: 潁川の人。清廉で人を見る目に優れた。荊州に住み、名士龐徳公から「水鏡」と呼ばれたと伝わる。
origin.en: A man of Yingchuan, pure-minded and a fine judge of men. He is said to have lived in Jing, where the worthy Pang Degong called him "Water Mirror".

origin.ja: 呉郡余杭の人。父の凌操は孫権に仕え、黄祖を攻めたとき甘寧に射殺された。
origin.en: A man of Yuhang in Wu. His father Ling Cao served Sun Quan and was shot dead by Gan Ning in the attack on Huang Zu.

origin.ja: 橋公の娘 (史書では「橋」と書く)。[[p:孫策]]が皖を落としたとき妹とともに迎えられ、孫策の妻となった。姉妹ともに国一番の美しさと記される。
origin.en: A daughter of Lord Qiao. When [[p:孫策|Sun Ce]] took Wan, she and her sister were found there; she became Sun Ce's wife. Both are recorded as the beauties of the land.

origin.ja: 橋公の娘 (史書では「橋」と書く) で、[[p:大喬]]の妹。[[p:孫策]]が皖を落としたとき姉とともに迎えられ、[[p:周瑜]]の妻となった。
origin.en: A daughter of Lord Qiao, younger sister of [[p:大喬|the Elder Qiao]]. Found at Wan when [[p:孫策|Sun Ce]] took it, she became the wife of [[p:周瑜|Zhou Yu]].

origin.ja: 琅邪開陽の人。歌い手の家の出で、二十歳のとき譙で[[p:曹操]]の妾となった。[[p:曹丕]]・[[p:曹植]]の母。
origin.en: A woman of Kaiyang in Langya, of a family of singers. At twenty she became a concubine of [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] at Qiao. Mother of [[p:曹丕|Cao Pi]] and [[p:曹植|Cao Zhi]].

origin.ja: 中山無極の人。漢の太保甄邯の子孫で、上蔡令甄逸の娘。[[p:袁紹]]の子袁熙の妻だったが、鄴が落ちたとき[[p:曹丕]]に迎えられた。
origin.en: A woman of Wuji in Zhongshan, descendant of the Han grand protector Zhen Han and daughter of Zhen Yi, magistrate of Shangcai. Wife of [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]]'s son Yuan Xi, she was taken by [[p:曹丕|Cao Pi]] when Ye fell.

origin.ja: 沔南の名士黄承彦の娘で、[[p:諸葛亮]]の妻。黄承彦は「娘は醜いが、才は君に釣り合う」と言って縁談を持ちかけたと伝わる。
origin.en: Daughter of Huang Chengyan, a worthy of Miannan, and wife of [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]]. Her father is said to have offered her with the words "she is plain, but her talent matches yours".

origin.ja: 涿郡涿県の人。前漢の景帝の子、中山靖王劉勝の末裔と称した。早く父を失い、母とともに草鞋を売り、むしろを織って暮らした。黄巾の乱で義勇兵を率いて身を起こした (『三国志』)。
origin.en: A man of Zhuo county in Zhuo commandery, who claimed descent from Liu Sheng, Prince Jing of Zhongshan, a son of Emperor Jing of Former Han. Fatherless early, he lived with his mother by selling straw sandals and weaving mats, and rose leading volunteers against the Yellow Turbans (Sanguozhi).

origin.ja: 扶風茂陵の人。後漢の伏波将軍馬援の子孫とされる馬騰の子。父が曹操に召されて都へ移ると、涼州に残ってその兵を率いた (『三国志』)。
origin.en: A man of Maoling in Fufeng, son of Ma Teng, held to descend from Ma Yuan, the Wave-Calming General of Later Han. When his father was summoned to the capital by Cao Cao, he stayed in Liang and led his troops (Sanguozhi).

origin.ja: 沛国豊の人。祖父の張陵が蜀で開いた教えを、父の張衡を経て受け継ぎ、漢中で信者たちを治めた (『三国志』)。
origin.en: A man of Feng in Pei. He inherited, by way of his father Zhang Heng, the teaching his grandfather Zhang Ling had founded in Shu, and ruled its believers in Hanzhong (Sanguozhi).

events.ja: 「蒼天すでに死す、黄天まさに立つべし」。[[p:張角]]の率いる黄巾の衆が各地で一斉に蜂起し、役所を焼き、官吏を殺した。
events.en: "The Blue Heaven is dead; the Yellow Heaven shall rise." [[p:張角|Zhang Jue]]'s Yellow Turbans rose everywhere at once, burning offices and killing officials.

events.ja: 涼州で辺章・[[p:韓遂]]らが羌族と結んで漢に背いた。西方の乱はこの後三十年近く続く。
events.en: In Liang, Bian Zhang, [[p:韓遂|Han Sui]] and others joined the Qiang and rose against the Han; the west would not be quiet for nearly thirty years.

events.ja: [[p:張角]]は病に倒れ、[[p:皇甫嵩]]らの官軍が弟の[[p:張梁]]・[[p:張宝]]を討って黄巾の本隊は滅んだ。だが残党は各地に散って暴れ続けた。
events.en: [[p:張角|Zhang Jue]] died of illness, and the imperial armies of [[p:皇甫嵩|Huangfu Song]] and others destroyed his brothers [[p:張梁|Zhang Liang]] and [[p:張宝|Zhang Bao]]. The remnants scattered and kept raiding everywhere.

events.ja: {r_han}は宮殿の修理のため官職を値をつけて売り出した。三公の位さえ金で買えた。
events.en: To rebuild the palaces {r_han} put offices up for sale; even the three highest posts could be bought.

events.ja: [[p:劉焉]]の進言で州の長官に兵と民を治める大きな権限 (州牧) が与えられた。劉焉は自ら益州牧となって蜀に入り、道を閉ざして独立の構えをとった。
events.en: On [[p:劉焉|Liu Yan]]'s advice the provincial governors were given great powers over troops and people. Liu Yan made himself governor of Yi, went into Shu, closed the roads and stood apart.

events.ja: 大将軍[[p:何進]]は宦官を除こうとして逆に宮中で殺された。怒った[[p:袁紹]]らは宮中に兵を入れ、宦官二千余人を皆殺しにした。混乱の中、西涼の[[p:董卓]]が軍を率いて洛陽に入った。
events.en: The grand general [[p:何進|He Jin]], plotting against the eunuchs, was killed by them in the palace. [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]] and others stormed in and killed more than two thousand eunuchs; in the chaos [[p:董卓|Dong Zhuo]] marched into Luoyang from the west.

events.ja: [[p:董卓]]は少帝を廃して陳留王を立てた ([[p:献帝]])。洛陽の宮殿は董卓の兵がほしいままに荒らした。
events.en: [[p:董卓|Dong Zhuo]] deposed the young emperor and set up the Prince of Chenliu ([[p:献帝|Emperor Xian]]). His soldiers plundered Luoyang as they pleased.

events.ja: 関東の諸侯が[[p:董卓]]討伐の兵を挙げ、[[p:袁紹]]を盟主に仰いだ。だが諸侯は互いに牽制して動かず、連合は自分の地盤を固める群雄の争いへと変わっていった。
events.en: The lords east of the passes raised troops against [[p:董卓|Dong Zhuo]] with [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]] as their leader. But they watched each other and would not move, and the alliance turned into a scramble of warlords building their own domains.

events.ja: [[p:董卓]]は洛陽を焼き払い、皇帝と数百万の民を長安へ移した。道中で多くの者が死んだ。
events.en: [[p:董卓|Dong Zhuo]] burned Luoyang and drove the emperor and millions of people to Chang'an; many died on the way.

events.ja: {r_wu}は陽人で[[p:董卓]]の軍を破り、その将華雄を討ち取った。董卓は洛陽の宮殿と陵墓を焼き払い、長安へ退いた。
events.en: {r_wu} broke [[p:董卓|Dong Zhuo]]'s army at Yangren and killed its general Hua Xiong. Dong Zhuo burned the palaces and tombs of Luoyang and fell back to Chang'an.

events.ja: [[p:孫堅]]は[[p:劉表]]を攻めて襄陽を囲んだが、峴山で伏兵の矢に当たって死んだ。
events.en: [[p:孫堅|Sun Jian]] besieged [[p:劉表|Liu Biao]] in Xiangyang and was killed by an ambusher's arrow on Mount Xian.

events.ja: [[p:劉焉]]に漢中へ遣わされた[[p:張魯]]は、その地で自立した。教えを奉じる者たちの互助で治め、三十年近く漢中を保つ。
events.en: Sent to Hanzhong by [[p:劉焉|Liu Yan]], [[p:張魯|Zhang Lu]] made himself independent there; he governed through the mutual aid of his believers and held Hanzhong for nearly thirty years.

events.ja: {r_yuanshao}は冀州牧の韓馥を脅して州を譲らせ、鄴に入った。
events.en: {r_yuanshao} pressed Han Fu, governor of Ji, into handing over the province and entered Ye.

do.en: the war of Yuan Shao and Gongsun Zan

events.ja: 界橋の戦い。[[a:baima|白馬の騎兵]]を率いる{r_gongsun}が{n_yuanshao}に挑んだが、麴義の弩兵に破られた。
events.en: At Jieqiao {r_gongsun} and his [[a:baima|white-horse cavalry]] challenged {n_yuanshao} and were broken by Qu Yi's crossbowmen.

events.ja: 界橋の戦い。{r_yuanshao}の将麴義は精兵八百を盾の陰に伏せ、{r_gongsun}の白馬の騎兵「白馬義従」が迫ると一斉に弩を放って打ち破った。
events.en: At Jieqiao, {r_yuanshao}'s general Qu Yi hid eight hundred picked men behind their shields; when the white-horse cavalry of {r_gongsun} charged, they loosed their crossbows all at once and broke it.

events.ja: [[p:王允]]の計で、[[p:董卓]]は養子の[[p:呂布]]に刺し殺された。長安の人々は歌い踊って喜んだが、董卓の部将李傕・郭汜が長安を攻め落とし、王允を殺した。
events.en: By [[p:王允|Wang Yun]]'s plan [[p:董卓|Dong Zhuo]] was stabbed to death by his adopted son [[p:呂布|Lü Bu]]. Chang'an danced in the streets — until Dong's captains Li Jue and Guo Si stormed the city and killed Wang Yun.

events.ja: {r_cao}は兗州に入った青州の黄巾三十万を降し、その精鋭を「[[a:qingzhou|青州兵]]」とした。
events.en: {r_cao} brought to submission three hundred thousand Yellow Turbans of Qing who had come into Yan, and made the best of them his "[[a:qingzhou|Qingzhou army]]".

events.ja: {r_yuanshu}は兗州へ攻め入ったが匡亭で{r_cao}に大敗し、南陽を捨てて九江の寿春に移った。南陽は{n_liubiao}の手に帰した。
events.en: {r_yuanshu} struck into Yan but was crushed by {r_cao} at Kuangting; he gave up Nanyang and moved to Shouchun in Jiujiang. Nanyang fell to {n_liubiao}.

events.ja: 父曹嵩を[[p:陶謙]]の兵に殺された{r_cao}は徐州に攻め入り、多くの民を殺した。
events.en: His father Cao Song killed by [[p:陶謙|Tao Qian]]'s men, {r_cao} invaded Xu and slaughtered many of its people.

events.ja: {r_cao}が徐州に出ている隙に、[[p:陳宮]]らが[[p:呂布]]を迎え入れて兗州で背いた。[[p:曹操]]は濮陽で呂布と一年余り戦った。
events.en: While {r_cao} was away in Xu, [[p:陳宮|Chen Gong]] and others let [[p:呂布|Lü Bu]] into Yan and rose; Cao fought Lü Bu at Puyang for more than a year.

events.ja: [[p:陶謙]]は死に臨み、徐州を客将の[[p:劉備]]に託した。
events.en: On his deathbed [[p:陶謙|Tao Qian]] left Xu to his guest commander [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]].

events.ja: [[p:孫策]]は[[p:袁術]]から父の旧臣を返してもらって長江を渡り、劉繇を破って江東に地盤を築いた。「小覇王」と呼ばれた。
events.en: [[p:孫策|Sun Ce]] got his father's old soldiers back from [[p:袁術|Yuan Shu]], crossed the Yangtze, defeated Liu Yao and built his base east of the river — "the Little Conqueror".

events.ja: 李傕と郭汜が長安で争うなか、[[p:献帝]]はわずかな近臣と長安を脱け出し、追っ手を逃れながら東へ向かった。翌年、焼け野原の洛陽に帰り着いた。
events.en: While Li Jue and Guo Si fought each other in Chang'an, [[p:献帝|Emperor Xian]] slipped away with a few followers and fled east, pursued all the way. The next year he reached Luoyang, a field of ashes.

events.ja: [[p:孫策]]は会稽の王朗を降し、江東を平らげた。
events.en: [[p:孫策|Sun Ce]] brought down Wang Lang of Kuaiji and pacified the land east of the river.

events.ja: [[p:劉備]]が[[p:袁術]]と戦っている隙に、身を寄せていた[[p:呂布]]が下邳を奪い、徐州の主となった。
events.en: While [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] fought [[p:袁術|Yuan Shu]], [[p:呂布|Lü Bu]], whom he had taken in, seized Xiapi and became master of Xu.

events.ja: 李傕らのもとを逃れて荒れ果てた洛陽に戻った[[p:献帝]]を、{r_cao}は許に迎えた。「天子を奉じて不臣を討つ」。以後、[[p:曹操]]は皇帝の名で諸侯に命じた。
events.en: {r_cao} received at Xu the emperor, who had escaped Li Jue and come back to the ruins of Luoyang. "Serving the Son of Heaven, punish the disloyal": from now on Cao gave orders to the lords in the emperor's name.

events.ja: 宛城の戦い。降ったはずの張繍が夜襲をかけ、{r_cao}の長子曹昂と護衛の[[p:典韋]]が討死した。
events.en: At Wancheng Zhang Xiu, who had surrendered, attacked by night; Cao's eldest son Cao Ang and his bodyguard [[p:典韋|Dian Wei]] were killed.

events.ja: {r_yuanshu}は寿春で皇帝を称し、国号を仲とした。群雄はこぞって背を向けた。
events.en: {r_yuanshu} proclaimed himself emperor at Shouchun, calling his dynasty Zhong; the warlords turned their backs on him one and all.

events.ja: {r_cao}は下邳を水攻めにした。部下に縛り上げられて降った[[p:呂布]]は「縄がきつい」と言ったが、[[p:曹操]]は[[p:劉備]]の一言で呂布を斬った。
events.en: {r_cao} flooded Xiapi. [[p:呂布|Lü Bu]], bound and handed over by his own men, complained the ropes were too tight; at a word from [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]], Cao had him executed.

events.ja: {r_yuanshao}は易京の楼閣を地下から掘り崩し、{r_gongsun}は妻子を殺して火の中で死んだ。[[p:袁紹]]は河北四州の主となった。
events.en: {r_yuanshao} mined the towers of Yijing; {r_gongsun} killed his family and died in the flames. [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]] was master of the four provinces north of the river.

events.ja: 落ちぶれた[[p:袁術]]は、蜜水を求めても得られず、「袁術ともあろう者がこのざまか」と叫んで血を吐いて死んだ。
events.en: Fallen on hard times, [[p:袁術|Yuan Shu]] asked for honey water and there was none. "Has Yuan Shu come to this?" he cried, and died vomiting blood.

events.ja: 宛の張繡は[[p:賈詡]]の勧めで{r_cao}に降った。かつて[[p:曹操]]の長子曹昂を討った仇であったが、曹操は手を取って迎え、息子に張繡の娘を娶らせた。
events.en: Zhang Xiu of Wan, on [[p:賈詡|Jia Xu]]'s advice, went over to {r_cao}. He had killed Cao's eldest son Cao Ang; yet Cao took him by the hand, welcomed him, and married his son to Zhang Xiu's daughter.

events.ja: [[p:献帝]]の帯に縫い込まれた密詔を受けたとして董承らが{r_cao}を除こうとしたが、露見して一族ことごとく殺された。加わっていた[[p:劉備]]は徐州で[[p:曹操]]に背いたが、攻められて[[p:袁紹]]のもとへ逃れた。
events.en: Dong Cheng and others, claiming a secret edict sewn into the emperor's girdle, plotted against {r_cao}; it came out and their families were put to death. [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]], who was in it, rose against Cao in Xu, was beaten, and fled to [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]].

events.ja: 白馬の戦い。{r_cao}のもとに身を寄せていた[[p:関羽]]は、万軍の中で[[p:袁紹]]の猛将[[p:顔良]]を刺してその首を取り、白馬の囲みを解いた。関羽は[[p:曹操]]の厚遇に報いたのち、贈り物を封じて[[p:劉備]]のもとへ去った。
events.en: At Baima [[p:関羽|Guan Yu]], then with {r_cao}, rode into the midst of the host, struck down [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]]'s champion [[p:顔良|Yan Liang]] and took his head, lifting the siege. Having repaid Cao's kindness, he sealed up the gifts he had been given and left to rejoin [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]].

events.ja: [[p:孫策]]は狩りの途中で旧主の仇を狙う刺客に襲われ、その傷がもとで死んだ。弟の[[p:孫権]]が十九歳で後を継いだ。
events.en: [[p:孫策|Sun Ce]] was attacked while hunting by men avenging their old master, and died of his wounds. His brother [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]] succeeded him at nineteen.

events.ja: 官渡の戦い。兵糧の尽きかけた{r_cao}は、[[p:袁紹]]のもとから寝返った許攸の進言で[[a:wuchao|烏巣の兵糧庫を夜襲して焼き]]、{n_yuanshao}の大軍を崩した。
events.en: The battle of Guandu. Running short of food, {r_cao} took the advice of Xu You, a defector from [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]], [[a:wuchao|raided the granary at Wuchao by night and burned it]]; the great host of {n_yuanshao} fell apart.

events.ja: [[p:劉備]]は{r_liubiao}のもとに身を寄せ、新野に置かれた。のちに劉備は、馬に乗らずに過ごすうち内股に肉がついたのを見て嘆いた (髀肉の嘆)。
events.en: [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] took refuge with {r_liubiao} and was stationed at Xinye. Years later, seeing his thighs grown fat from never riding, he wept for the time slipping by.

events.ja: [[p:袁紹]]は失意のうちに病死した。後継ぎを定めなかったため、長子袁譚と末子[[p:袁尚]]が争った。
events.en: [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]] died of illness and disappointment. He had named no heir, and his eldest son Yuan Tan and youngest [[p:袁尚|Yuan Shang]] fought each other.

events.ja: {r_cao}は漳河の水を引いて鄴を落とした。袁氏の地盤は崩れた。
events.en: {r_cao} diverted the Zhang river, took Ye, and the Yuan domain crumbled.

events.ja: {r_cao}は南皮で袁譚を討ち、冀州・青州を平らげた。[[p:袁尚]]は烏桓のもとへ逃れた。
events.en: {r_cao} killed Yuan Tan at Nanpi and pacified Ji and Qing; [[p:袁尚|Yuan Shang]] fled to the Wuhuan.

events.ja: 白狼山の戦い。{r_cao}は険しい道を越えて{n_wuhuan}の単于蹋頓を討った。遠征に従った[[p:郭嘉]]は帰途に病で死んだ。
events.en: The battle of White Wolf Mountain. Crossing rough country, {r_cao} defeated and killed Tadun, chief of {n_wuhuan}. [[p:郭嘉|Guo Jia]], who had come on the campaign, died of illness on the way back.

events.ja: 新野にいた[[p:劉備]]は、隆中の[[p:諸葛亮]]の庵を三度訪ねてようやく会えた。諸葛亮は荊州と益州を取って天下を三分する策を説いた (天下三分の計)。
events.en: [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]], at Xinye, called three times at [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]]'s cottage in Longzhong before he was received. Zhuge Liang laid out his plan: take Jing and Yi and divide the realm in three.

events.ja: 三公の職が廃され、{r_cao}が丞相となって朝廷の実権を一手に握った。
events.en: The three highest offices were abolished and {r_cao} became chancellor, holding all the power of the court.

events.ja: [[p:劉表]]が病死すると、子の[[p:劉琮]]は戦わずに{n_cao}に降った。南へ逃れる[[p:劉備]]の一行は長坂で追いつかれ、[[p:趙雲]]は劉備の幼子を抱いて敵中を駆け抜けた。
events.en: When [[p:劉表|Liu Biao]] died, his son [[p:劉琮|Liu Cong]] surrendered to {n_cao} without a fight. [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]]'s column fleeing south was overtaken at Changban; [[p:趙雲|Zhao Yun]] rode through the enemy carrying Liu Bei's infant son.

events.ja: 長坂の戦い。{r_cao}は精鋭の騎兵で南へ逃れる[[p:劉備]]を追い、長坂で追いついた。[[p:張飛]]は橋を断って川を前に立ちはだかり、[[p:趙雲]]は劉備の子阿斗を抱いて囲みを破った。
events.en: At Changban {r_cao}'s best horsemen overtook [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] fleeing south. [[p:張飛|Zhang Fei]] broke the bridge and stood at the river; [[p:趙雲|Zhao Yun]] cut his way out holding Liu Bei's infant son.

events.ja: 赤壁の戦い。{r_wu}は[[p:周瑜]]に兵を預け、[[p:劉備]]と結んで{n_cao}の大軍を長江に迎えた。[[p:黄蓋]]の偽りの降伏とともに火を放った船が[[p:曹操]]の船団を焼き、疫病にも苦しんだ曹操軍は北へ退いた。
events.en: The battle of the Red Cliffs. {r_wu} gave [[p:周瑜|Zhou Yu]] command and, allied with [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]], met the great host of {n_cao} on the Yangtze. Fire ships sent in with [[p:黄蓋|Huang Gai]]'s false surrender burned Cao's fleet; plagued by sickness too, Cao's army withdrew north.

events.ja: [[p:劉備]]は荊州南部の長沙・零陵・桂陽・武陵の四郡を平らげ、ついに自らの地盤を得た。[[p:孫権]]は妹を劉備に嫁がせて同盟を固めた。
events.en: [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] took the four southern commanderies of Jing — Changsha, Lingling, Guiyang and Wuling — and had at last a base of his own. [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]] sealed the alliance by marrying his sister to him.

events.ja: [[p:周瑜]]は一年余り[[p:曹仁]]と戦い、江陵を落とした。
events.en: After more than a year against [[p:曹仁|Cao Ren]], [[p:周瑜|Zhou Yu]] took Jiangling.

events.ja: [[p:周瑜]]が病死すると、[[p:魯粛]]の勧めで{r_wu}は江陵を[[p:劉備]]に貸し与え、[[p:曹操]]への備えとした。
events.en: When [[p:周瑜|Zhou Yu]] died of illness, {r_wu}, on [[p:魯粛|Lu Su]]'s advice, lent Jiangling to [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] as a bulwark against Cao.

events.ja: {r_cao}は鄴に銅雀台を築いた。[[p:曹植]]は「銅雀台の賦」を詠んだ。
events.en: {r_cao} built the Bronze Sparrow Terrace at Ye; [[p:曹植|Cao Zhi]] wrote a rhapsody on it.

events.ja: 潼関の戦い。{r_cao}は[[p:賈詡]]の離間の計で[[p:馬超]]と[[p:韓遂]]を仲違いさせ、関中の軍閥を破った。
events.en: The battle of Tong Pass. Using [[p:賈詡|Jia Xu]]'s ploy to set [[p:馬超|Ma Chao]] and [[p:韓遂|Han Sui]] at odds, {r_cao} broke the warlords of the land within the passes.

events.ja: {r_wu}は都を秣陵に移し、建業と改めた。
events.en: {r_wu} moved his seat to Moling and renamed it Jianye.

events.ja: 濡須口の戦い。[[p:孫権]]の軍の整然とした様子を見た[[p:曹操]]は「子を生まば孫仲謀の如くなるべし」と嘆じて兵を引いた。
events.en: At the Ruxu estuary [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] saw the order of [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]]'s army, sighed "a son should be like Sun Zhongmou," and withdrew.

events.ja: {r_cao}は魏公に封じられ、九錫を加えられた。鄴に魏の社稷と宗廟が建てられ、漢の中にもう一つの国ができた。
events.en: {r_cao} was made Duke of Wei and given the Nine Bestowments; Wei's altars and ancestral temple went up at Ye — a state within the Han.

events.ja: [[p:馬超]]は西方で再起を図ったが敗れ、[[p:張魯]]のもとを経て[[p:劉備]]に降った。涼州は{n_cao}のものとなった。
events.en: [[p:馬超|Ma Chao]] tried to rise again in the west, failed, and by way of [[p:張魯|Zhang Lu]] went over to [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]]; Liang fell to {n_cao}.

events.ja: {r_shu}は益州に入り、成都を囲んだ。[[p:劉璋]]は「民を苦しめるに忍びない」と城を開いた。途中、軍師の[[p:龐統]]が流れ矢に当たって死んだ。
events.en: {r_shu} entered Yi and besieged Chengdu. [[p:劉璋|Liu Zhang]] opened the gates, "unwilling to make the people suffer". On the way the strategist [[p:龐統|Pang Tong]] was killed by a stray arrow.

events.ja: 伏皇后が父に{r_cao}を除くよう頼んだ古い手紙が見つかり、皇后は引き出されて殺された。[[p:献帝]]は「朕もいつまで命があるか分からぬ」と嘆いた。
events.en: An old letter in which Empress Fu had begged her father to rid the court of {r_cao} came to light; she was dragged out and put to death. "I do not know how long I shall live myself," the emperor lamented.

events.ja: 荊州の返還をめぐって[[p:劉備]]と[[p:孫権]]が争い、湘水を境に荊州を分けることで和した。
events.en: [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] and [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]] quarrelled over the return of Jing, and settled by dividing it along the Xiang river.

events.ja: 合肥の戦い。[[p:張遼]]はわずか八百の兵で十万の{n_wu}軍に斬り込み、[[p:孫権]]をあと一歩まで追い詰めた。江東では泣く子も「張遼が来る」と聞くと泣きやんだという。
events.en: The battle of Hefei. With just eight hundred men [[p:張遼|Zhang Liao]] charged the hundred thousand of {n_wu} and came within a step of [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]]. In the east, it is said, crying children fell silent at the words "Zhang Liao is coming".

events.ja: {r_zhanglu}は{n_cao}に降った。倉を封じて「これは国家のもの」と言い残して去った[[p:張魯]]を、[[p:曹操]]は厚く遇した。
events.en: {r_zhanglu} surrendered to {n_cao}. He had sealed his granaries — "these belong to the state" — and Cao treated him generously.

events.ja: {r_cao}は魏王に封じられた。
events.en: {r_cao} was made King of Wei.

events.ja: 大きな疫病がはやり、建安の文人たち (王粲・陳琳・劉楨・徐幹・応瑒) が相次いで世を去った。[[p:曹丕]]は「家々に骨肉の死を悼む声がある」と書いた。
events.en: A great plague swept the land, and the poets of the Jian'an years — Wang Can, Chen Lin, Liu Zhen, Xu Gan and Ying Yang — died one after another. "In every house there is mourning," wrote [[p:曹丕|Cao Pi]].

events.ja: 定軍山の戦い。老将[[p:黄忠]]が[[p:夏侯淵]]を討ち取り、{r_shu}は漢中を手に入れた。[[p:曹操]]は漢中を[[a:jilei|「鶏肋」]]と呼んで兵を引いた。
events.en: The battle of Mount Dingjun. The old general [[p:黄忠|Huang Zhong]] killed [[p:夏侯淵|Xiahou Yuan]], and {r_shu} won Hanzhong. [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] called it "[[a:jilei|a chicken rib]]" — not much meat, a pity to throw away — and withdrew.

events.ja: {r_shu}の養子劉封と[[p:孟達]]が上庸を攻め取り、太守の申耽は降った。
events.en: Liu Feng, adopted son of {r_shu}, and [[p:孟達|Meng Da]] took Shangyong; its governor Shen Dan surrendered.

events.ja: {r_shu}は漢中王を称した。
events.en: {r_shu} took the title King of Hanzhong.

events.ja: [[p:関羽]]は樊城を囲み、長雨で漢水があふれた機に[[p:于禁]]の七軍を水没させて降した。関羽の威名は中原を震わせ、[[p:曹操]]は都を移すことさえ考えた。
events.en: [[p:関羽|Guan Yu]] besieged Fancheng; when long rains flooded the Han river, he drowned [[p:于禁|Yu Jin]]'s seven armies and took his surrender. His name shook the Central Plain, and [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] even thought of moving the capital.

events.ja: [[p:呂蒙]]は兵を商人に変装させて長江を渡り、[[p:関羽]]の留守の荊州を奪った。退路を断たれた関羽は捕らえられて斬られた。
events.en: [[p:呂蒙|Lü Meng]] disguised his soldiers as merchants, crossed the Yangtze and took Jing behind [[p:関羽|Guan Yu]]'s back. Cut off, Guan Yu was captured and executed.

events.ja: [[p:曹操]]は洛陽で世を去った。遺言で、自らの墓に金銀の宝を納めることを禁じた。
events.en: [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] died at Luoyang. He ordered that no gold or silver be laid in his tomb.

events.ja: [[p:関羽]]を救わなかったことを責められるのを恐れて、[[p:孟達]]は手勢を連れて魏に降り、上庸は再び魏のものとなった。劉封は成都に逃げ帰り、[[p:劉備]]に死を賜った。
events.en: Fearing blame for not saving [[p:関羽|Guan Yu]], [[p:孟達|Meng Da]] went over to Wei with his men, and Shangyong was Wei's again. Liu Feng fled back to Chengdu, where [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] ordered him to die.

events.ja: [[p:献帝]]は帝位を{r_cao}に譲った。四百年続いた漢は終わり、魏の世が始まった。
events.en: [[p:献帝|Emperor Xian]] yielded the throne to {r_cao}. The Han, four hundred years old, was at an end, and the age of Wei began.

events.ja: {r_wu}は都を公安から鄂に移し、武昌と名を改めた。荊州をうかがう[[p:劉備]]への備えである。
events.en: {r_wu} moved his seat from Gong'an to E and renamed it Wuchang, to face [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]], who had his eyes on Jing.

events.ja: {r_shu}は成都で皇帝の位に即き、漢の後継を名のった (蜀漢)。まもなく[[p:張飛]]が部下に殺された。
events.en: {r_shu} took the throne at Chengdu as heir of the Han (the "Shu Han"). Soon after, [[p:張飛|Zhang Fei]] was murdered by his own men.

events.ja: 夷陵の戦い。[[p:関羽]]の仇を討とうと攻め込んだ{r_shu}の大軍を、{n_wu}の[[p:陸遜]]は長く守って疲れさせ、夏の暑さの中、連なる陣に火を放って大破した。[[p:劉備]]は白帝城へ逃れた。
events.en: The battle of Yiling. {r_shu} invaded to avenge [[p:関羽|Guan Yu]]; [[p:陸遜|Lu Xun]] of {n_wu} held off until the great army was worn out, then in the summer heat set fire to its long line of camps and broke it. [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] fled to Baidi.

events.ja: {r_wu}は年号を立て、呉の国を名のった。
events.en: {r_wu} proclaimed his own era and named his realm Wu.

events.ja: [[p:劉備]]は白帝城で世を去った。死に臨んで[[p:諸葛亮]]に「子が補佐に足る者なら補佐せよ。才がなければ、君が国を取れ」と言った。諸葛亮は呉と和を結び直した。
events.en: [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] died at Baidi. On his deathbed he told [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]]: "If my son is worth helping, help him; if not, take the realm yourself." Zhuge Liang renewed the alliance with Wu.

events.ja: [[p:諸葛亮]]は南中に兵を進め、[[p:孟獲]]を七度捕らえて七度放ち、心から服させたと伝えられる。
events.en: [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]] marched into Nanzhong; he captured [[p:孟獲|Meng Huo]] seven times and seven times let him go, so the tale goes, until he submitted from the heart.

events.ja: [[p:諸葛亮]]は北伐に先立って「出師の表」を奉り、[[p:劉禅]]に国の行く末を説いた。
events.en: Before marching north [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]] presented his memorial on going to war, setting out for [[p:劉禅|Liu Shan]] the course of the realm.

events.ja: [[p:諸葛亮]]が祁山に出ると、天水・南安・安定の三郡が魏に背いて蜀に応じた。関中は震え上がった。
events.en: When [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]] came out at Qishan, the three commanderies of Tianshui, Nan'an and Anding rose against Wei and went over to Shu. The land within the passes shook.

events.ja: 第一次北伐。街亭を任された[[p:馬謖]]は命に背いて山上に陣を張り、[[p:張郃]]に水を断たれて大敗した。[[p:諸葛亮]]は泣いて馬謖を斬った。天水の[[p:姜維]]が蜀に降った。
events.en: The first northern campaign. [[p:馬謖|Ma Su]], left to hold Jieting, disobeyed orders, camped on a hill, was cut off from water by [[p:張郃|Zhang He]] and routed. Weeping, [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]] had him executed. [[p:姜維|Jiang Wei]] of Tianshui went over to Shu.

events.ja: 石亭の戦い。{r_wu}の鄱陽太守周魴が偽りの降伏で魏の曹休を誘い込み、[[p:陸遜]]がこれを大いに破った。曹休は恥じて病み、まもなく死んだ。
events.en: At Shiting, Zhou Fang of {r_wu} lured Wei's Cao Xiu in with a false surrender, and [[p:陸遜|Lu Xun]] crushed him. Cao Xiu sickened with shame and soon died.

events.ja: {r_wu}は皇帝の位に即いた。天下に三人の皇帝が並び立つ三国の世となった。
events.en: {r_wu} took the imperial throne. Three emperors now stood side by side — the age of the Three Kingdoms.

events.ja: 祁山から退く{n_shu}の軍を追った魏の[[p:張郃]]は、木門道で伏兵の矢を膝に受けて死んだ。
events.en: Pursuing the army of {n_shu} back from Qishan, Wei's [[p:張郃|Zhang He]] was struck in the knee by an arrow from an ambush at Mumen and died.

events.ja: [[p:諸葛亮]]の死後、撤退をめぐって[[p:魏延]]と楊儀が争い、魏延は南鄭へ逃れたところを[[p:馬岱]]に斬られた。
events.en: After [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]] died, [[p:魏延|Wei Yan]] and Yang Yi fell out over the retreat; Wei Yan fled toward Nanzheng and was cut down by [[p:馬岱|Ma Dai]].

events.ja: 五丈原で[[p:司馬懿]]と対陣中、[[p:諸葛亮]]は陣中で病死した。蜀軍が退くとき、追ってきた司馬懿は蜀軍が反撃の構えを見せると慌てて退き、人々は「[[a:sishi_kongming|死せる孔明]]、生ける仲達を走らす」と笑った。
events.en: Facing [[p:司馬懿|Sima Yi]] at Wuzhangyuan, [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]] died of illness in camp. As the Shu army withdrew, Sima Yi pursued — and fled when it turned as if to fight. "[[a:sishi_kongming|The dead Kongming put the living Zhongda to flight]]," people laughed.

events.ja: 諸葛恪は丹陽の山越を三年かけて山から降ろし、四万の兵を得た。
events.en: Over three years Zhuge Ke brought the Shanyue of Danyang down from the hills, and gained forty thousand soldiers.

events.ja: [[p:司馬懿]]は遼東の公孫淵を討ち滅ぼした。
events.en: [[p:司馬懿|Sima Yi]] destroyed Gongsun Yuan of Liaodong.

events.ja: {n_cao}の明帝 ([[p:曹叡]]) は死に臨み、八歳の[[p:曹芳]]を曹爽と[[p:司馬懿]]に託した。
events.en: Dying, Emperor Ming of {n_cao} left the eight-year-old [[p:曹芳|Cao Fang]] in the hands of Cao Shuang and [[p:司馬懿|Sima Yi]].

events.ja: 興勢の役。名を上げようと漢中に攻め入った{n_cao}の曹爽は、王平・[[p:費禕]]に険しい山道で阻まれ、牛馬を多く失って退いた。
events.en: Cao Shuang of {n_cao}, seeking glory, struck at Hanzhong, was held in the mountain passes by Wang Ping and [[p:費禕|Fei Yi]], and fell back having lost much of his baggage animals.

events.ja: 高平陵の変。皇帝が陵墓に詣でて都を空けた隙に、[[p:司馬懿]]は兵を挙げて実権を握る曹爽を除いた。魏の政は司馬氏のものとなった。
events.en: The Gaoping Tombs incident. While the emperor was away at the tombs, [[p:司馬懿|Sima Yi]] took up arms and removed Cao Shuang from power. The government of Wei belonged to the Sima.

events.ja: {r_wu}の晩年、太子と魯王の跡目争い (二宮の変) で多くの重臣が罰せられ、[[p:陸遜]]も憤死した。
events.en: In the last years of {r_wu} the quarrel between the crown prince and the Prince of Lu over the succession cost many great ministers their places; [[p:陸遜|Lu Xun]] died of grief and anger.

events.ja: 寿春の王淩が[[p:司馬懿]]を除こうと謀ったが、司馬懿は軍を率いて急襲し、王淩は降って自ら命を絶った (寿春の三度の乱の一つ目)。
events.en: Wang Ling at Shouchun plotted against [[p:司馬懿|Sima Yi]]; Sima Yi fell on him with an army, and Wang Ling surrendered and took his own life — the first of the three risings at Shouchun.

events.ja: 東興の戦い。[[p:孫権]]の死に乗じて攻め寄せた魏の大軍を、{n_wu}の諸葛恪が迎え撃った。雪の中、[[p:丁奉]]らは鎧を脱ぎ短い武器だけを持って魏の陣に斬り込み、魏軍は浮橋が落ちて多くが溺れた。
events.en: At Dongxing, Zhuge Ke of {n_wu} met the great army Wei had sent on the death of [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]]. In the snow [[p:丁奉|Ding Feng]] and his men threw off their armour and went in with short blades; the pontoon bridge broke and many of the Wei soldiers drowned.

events.ja: {n_shu}の大将軍[[p:費禕]]は、正月の宴で魏から降った郭循に刺し殺された。
events.en: [[p:費禕|Fei Yi]], grand general of {n_shu}, was stabbed to death at the New Year feast by Guo Xun, a defector from Wei.

events.ja: {n_wu}の諸葛恪は二十万の兵で合肥新城を囲んだが、守将張特の策に阻まれ、疫病で多くを失って退いた。冬、諸葛恪は孫峻に宴席で殺された。
events.en: Zhuge Ke of {n_wu} besieged the new city of Hefei with two hundred thousand men, was held off by the defender Zhang Te's ruses, lost many to plague and withdrew. That winter Sun Jun killed him at a banquet.

events.ja: 寿春の毌丘倹と文欽が[[p:司馬師]]を除こうと兵を挙げたが敗れた (二度目の乱)。眼病を押して出陣した司馬師は、帰りに許昌で死んだ。
events.en: Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin rose at Shouchun against [[p:司馬師|Sima Shi]] and were beaten — the second rising. Sima Shi, who had taken the field despite a diseased eye, died at Xuchang on the way back.

events.ja: 段谷の戦い。北伐に出た{n_shu}の[[p:姜維]]は、約束の援軍が来ないまま魏の[[p:鄧艾]]に大敗し、多くの兵を失った。蜀の人々は姜維の北伐をうらむようになった。
events.en: At Duangu, [[p:姜維|Jiang Wei]] of {n_shu}, out on campaign, was crushed by Wei's [[p:鄧艾|Deng Ai]] when the promised reinforcements never came, and lost many men. Shu began to resent his campaigns.

events.ja: 寿春の諸葛誕が{n_wu}と結んで[[p:司馬昭]]に背いた (三度目の乱)。司馬昭は二十六万の大軍で寿春を囲み、翌年二月に城は落ちて諸葛誕は斬られた。その部下数百人は最後まで降らず、皆斬られた。
events.en: Zhuge Dan at Shouchun joined with {n_wu} against [[p:司馬昭|Sima Zhao]] — the third rising. Sima Zhao surrounded Shouchun with two hundred and sixty thousand men; the next spring it fell and Zhuge Dan was beheaded. Hundreds of his men would not surrender to the end, and were killed to a man.

events.ja: {n_wu}の孫綝は[[p:孫亮]]を廃して[[p:孫休]]を立てたが、孫休は[[p:丁奉]]らと謀り、年の暮れの朝会で孫綝を捕らえて斬った。
events.en: Sun Lin of {n_wu} deposed [[p:孫亮|Sun Liang]] and set up [[p:孫休|Sun Xiu]]; but Sun Xiu plotted with [[p:丁奉|Ding Feng]] and had Sun Lin seized and beheaded at the year-end court.

events.ja: 「[[p:司馬昭]]の心は路人も知る所なり」。皇帝[[p:曹髦]]は宮中の兵を率いて司馬昭を討とうとし、返り討ちにあって殺された。
events.en: "The heart of [[p:司馬昭|Sima Zhao]] is known to every passer-by." The emperor [[p:曹髦|Cao Mao]] led the palace guards against Sima Zhao and was killed.

events.ja: 竹林の七賢の一人[[p:嵆康]]が、[[p:司馬昭]]に疎まれて刑場に引かれた。嵆康は日影を見て琴を求め、「広陵散」を弾き終えると「広陵散はここに絶える」と言って刑を受けた。
events.en: [[p:嵆康|Ji Kang]], one of the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove, fell foul of [[p:司馬昭|Sima Zhao]] and was led to execution. Looking at the shadows, he asked for his zither, played "Guangling san" to the end — "it dies with me" — and met his death.

events.ja: {n_cao}の[[p:鄧艾]]は陰平の山道七百里を、谷には橋を架け、崖では毛氈にくるまって転げ落ちながら越え、綿竹で[[p:諸葛亮]]の子諸葛瞻を討ち取った。成都は目の前であった。
events.en: [[p:鄧艾|Deng Ai]] of {n_cao} crossed seven hundred li of mountain tracks from Yinping — bridging the gorges, rolling down the cliffs wrapped in felt — and killed [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]]'s son Zhuge Zhan at Mianzhu. Chengdu lay before him.

events.ja: [[p:鄧艾]]は陰平の険しい山道を毛氈にくるまって転がり降り、成都に迫った。{r_shu}は降伏した。[[p:劉禅]]はのちに洛陽で「ここは楽しく、蜀を思い出しません」と答えたという。
events.en: [[p:鄧艾|Deng Ai]] went down the precipices of Yinping wrapped in felt, rolling, and appeared before Chengdu; {r_shu} surrendered. Later at Luoyang, asked if he missed Shu, [[p:劉禅|Liu Shan]] is said to have answered: "I am so happy here I never think of it."

events.ja: 蜀を平らげた[[p:鍾会]]は、降った[[p:姜維]]と結んで成都で背こうとしたが、兵たちが騒ぎ立てて鍾会も姜維も殺された。[[p:鄧艾]]も護送の途中で殺された。
events.en: [[p:鍾会|Zhong Hui]], Shu conquered, plotted with the surrendered [[p:姜維|Jiang Wei]] to rise at Chengdu; his soldiers mutinied and both were killed. [[p:鄧艾|Deng Ai]] was murdered on his way back under guard.

events.ja: [[p:司馬炎]]は魏の元帝から位を譲られ、晋を建てた。
events.en: [[p:司馬炎|Sima Yan]] received the throne from the last emperor of Wei and founded the Jin.

events.ja: {n_wu}の西陵の督歩闡が晋に降った。[[p:陸抗]]は長い囲いを築いて晋の援軍を退け、西陵を取り戻した。
events.en: Bu Chan, commander of Xiling for {n_wu}, went over to Jin. [[p:陸抗|Lu Kang]] walled the city in, beat off the Jin relief and won Xiling back.

events.ja: 国境を挟んで対峙した晋の[[p:羊祜]]と呉の[[p:陸抗]]は、互いに酒と薬を贈り合い、敵ながら信を通わせた。
events.en: Across the border, [[p:羊祜|Yang Hu]] of Jin and [[p:陸抗|Lu Kang]] of Wu sent each other wine and medicine, and trusted each other though enemies.

events.ja: {n_cao}は二十万の兵を六つの道から{n_wu}へ進めた。益州からは王濬の大きな楼船の艦隊が長江を下り、呉が江に張った鉄の鎖を、松明の筏で焼き切って進んだ。
events.en: {n_cao} sent two hundred thousand men against {n_wu} by six roads. From Yi, Wang Jun's fleet of great tower ships came down the Yangzi, burning through the iron chains Wu had strung across the river with blazing rafts.

events.ja: 晋の大軍が長江の上流と北から攻め下り、王濬の水軍が建業に入った。{r_wu}は降伏し、百年近く分かれていた天下は再び一つになった。
events.en: The armies of Jin came down the Yangtze and from the north, and Wang Jun's fleet entered Jianye. {r_wu} surrendered, and the realm, divided for nearly a century, was one again.

deploy.ja: 河北四州を従えた[[p:袁紹]]は十万を超える兵で南下し、黄河を渡った。[[p:曹操]]は兵力で大きく劣り、官渡に砦を築いて守りに入った。前哨戦の白馬では[[p:関羽]]が[[p:顔良]]を斬り、延津では[[p:文醜]]も討たれた。
deploy.en: Master of the four provinces north of the river, [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]] came south across the Yellow River with more than a hundred thousand men. Far outnumbered, [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] fortified Guandu and stood on the defensive. In the opening fights [[p:関羽|Guan Yu]] cut down [[p:顔良|Yan Liang]] at Baima, and [[p:文醜|Wen Chou]] was killed at Yanjin.

plan.ja: [[p:袁紹]]は土山や櫓を築いて[[p:曹操]]の陣に矢を降らせ、曹操は「霹靂車」(投石機) で櫓を砕いた。地下道を掘れば堀で防いだ。数か月のにらみ合いで曹操の兵糧は尽きかけ、[[p:荀彧]]に「退きたい」と書き送るほどであった。そこへ袁紹の参謀許攸が寝返り、兵糧の集積地烏巣の場所を告げた。曹操は自ら五千の兵を率い、袁軍の旗を掲げて夜道を進み、烏巣を焼いた。袁紹が送った[[p:張郃]]・高覧は曹操の本陣を落とせず、そのまま曹操に降った。
plan.en: [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]] raised earth mounds and towers to rain arrows into [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]]'s camp; Cao Cao smashed them with his "thunderbolt carts" — stone-throwers. Yuan dug tunnels; Cao dug trenches across them. Months passed; Cao Cao's grain ran so low that he wrote to [[p:荀彧|Xun Yu]] of retreat. Then Yuan Shao's adviser Xu You came over and told him where the grain lay — at Wuchao. Cao Cao led five thousand himself by night under Yuan banners and burned it. [[p:張郃|Zhang He]] and Gao Lan, sent against Cao's camp, could not take it and went over to him.

tales.ja: 許攸が来たと聞いた[[p:曹操]]は、裸足のまま飛び出して迎えた。許攸が「兵糧はいかほどか」と問うと曹操は「一年分はある」「いや半年」と言を濁し、ついに「実はひと月分だ」と打ち明けたという。
tales.en: When he heard Xu You had come, [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] ran out barefoot to greet him. Asked how much grain he had, he said a year's, then half a year's, and at last admitted: one month.

tales.ja: 勝った[[p:曹操]]は、[[p:袁紹]]の陣から自軍の者が袁紹に送った内通の手紙の束を見つけたが、読まずにすべて焼かせた。「袁紹が強かったときは、わたしでさえ身を守れるか分からなかった」と言って。
tales.en: In [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]]'s camp [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] found a bundle of letters his own men had written to the enemy. He had them burned unread: "When Yuan Shao was strong, even I did not know if I could save myself."

tales.ja: [[p:沮授]]は持久戦を説いて退けられ、捕らえられても降らず、[[p:袁紹]]のもとへ逃げ帰ろうとして殺された。[[p:田豊]]は「戦うな」と諫めて獄につながれ、敗戦を恥じた袁紹に殺された。
tales.en: [[p:沮授|Ju Shou]] had urged a slow war and was overruled; captured, he would not submit, and was killed trying to escape back to [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]]. [[p:田豊|Tian Feng]], jailed for advising against the battle, was put to death by Yuan Shao, ashamed of his defeat.

after.ja: [[p:袁紹]]は二年後に病死し、子の袁譚と[[p:袁尚]]が争う間に、[[p:曹操]]は河北を平らげた。華北の覇者は曹操と決まった。
after.en: [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]] died two years later, and while his sons Yuan Tan and [[p:袁尚|Yuan Shang]] fought each other [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] took the north. The master of northern China was Cao Cao.

deploy.ja: 荊州を降した[[p:曹操]]は、二十万 (号して八十万) と荊州の水軍を率いて長江を下った。[[p:孫権]]は[[p:周瑜]]・[[p:程普]]に三万を与え、[[p:劉備]]の二万と合わせて赤壁で迎え撃った。
deploy.en: With Jing province in hand, [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] came down the Yangzi with two hundred thousand men — he claimed eight hundred thousand — and the Jing fleet. [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]] gave [[p:周瑜|Zhou Yu]] and [[p:程普|Cheng Pu]] thirty thousand, and with [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]]'s twenty thousand they met him at the Red Cliffs.

plan.ja: 北方の兵は船に慣れず、疫病も広がっていた。[[p:曹操]]の船は鎖でつながれていたとも、ただ密集していたともいう。[[p:黄蓋]]は偽りの降伏状を送り、油をしみ込ませた柴草を積んだ十艘の船に幕をかけて東南の風に乗せた。間近で火を放つと、炎は曹操の船団から岸の陣営にまで燃え広がった。[[p:周瑜]]は精兵で追い討ち、曹操は華容道のぬかるみを、兵に草を敷かせて逃れた。
plan.en: The northern soldiers were no sailors, and plague was in their camp. [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]]'s ships were chained together, some say — or simply crowded. [[p:黄蓋|Huang Gai]] sent a false letter of surrender, filled ten ships with brushwood soaked in oil, covered them with curtains and sailed on the southeast wind. Fired close in, they set the whole fleet ablaze, and the flames ran up into the camps on shore. [[p:周瑜|Zhou Yu]] followed with his best men; Cao Cao escaped along the swampy Huarong road, his soldiers laying grass so the horses could pass.

tales.ja: 「周郎 ([[p:周瑜]]) は曲を一つ間違えればすぐ振り返る」と歌われるほど音楽に通じた美男で、[[p:孫策]]とは同い年の義兄弟、妻はそれぞれ「二喬」と呼ばれた美人姉妹であった。
tales.en: "If a note is wrong, young Master Zhou turns his head," went the song: [[p:周瑜|Zhou Yu]] was a handsome man with a fine ear, the sworn brother of [[p:孫策|Sun Ce]], born the same year; their wives were the two Qiao sisters, famed beauties.

tales.ja: 開戦をためらう家臣たちの前で、[[p:孫権]]は剣を抜いて机の角を斬り落とし、「なお降伏を言う者はこの机と同じになる」と言い放った。
tales.en: Before ministers who wanted to surrender, [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]] drew his sword and cut off a corner of his desk: "Anyone who speaks of surrender again will be like this desk."

tales.ja: [[p:諸葛亮]]が風を祈ったり、藁人形の船で矢を集めたりする話は、後の物語の創作である。
tales.en: [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]] praying for the wind, or gathering arrows with straw-man boats, are inventions of later fiction.

after.ja: [[p:曹操]]は北へ退き、天下統一の機を失った。荊州南部は[[p:劉備]]が取り、天下三分の形が生まれる。
after.en: [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] went back north and the chance to unite the realm was gone. [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] took southern Jing, and the three-way split of the realm took shape.

deploy.ja: [[p:曹操]]が漢中へ出ている隙に、[[p:孫権]]は十万で合肥を囲んだ。守るのは[[p:張遼]]・[[p:楽進]]・李典の七千であった。
deploy.en: With [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] away in Hanzhong, [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]] besieged Hefei with a hundred thousand. Inside were [[p:張遼|Zhang Liao]], [[p:楽進|Yue Jin]] and Li Dian with seven thousand.

plan.ja: [[p:曹操]]が残した手紙には「敵が来たら[[p:張遼]]と李典は出て戦え、[[p:楽進]]は守れ」とあった。張遼は決死の兵八百を募り、夜明けに自ら先頭に立って[[p:孫権]]の本陣へ斬り込んだ。孫権は丘に逃れ、呉軍の士気はくじけた。十数日の後に孫権が退くと、張遼は逍遥津の橋で追い討ち、孫権は橋の壊れた所を馬に跳ばせてようやく逃れた。
plan.en: The letter [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] had left read: "If the enemy comes, [[p:張遼|Zhang Liao]] and Li Dian go out to fight; [[p:楽進|Yue Jin]] holds the walls." Zhang Liao picked eight hundred men ready to die, and at dawn led them himself into [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]]'s camp. Sun Quan fled to a hill and the heart went out of the Wu army. When it fell back some days later, Zhang Liao struck again at the Xiaoyao ford, and Sun Quan escaped only by making his horse leap a broken span of the bridge.

tales.ja: 江東では泣く子に「遼来々 ([[p:張遼]]が来るぞ)」と言うと泣きやんだという (後の言い伝え)。
tales.en: In the lands south of the river, the story goes, a crying child would hush at "[[p:張遼|Zhang Liao]] is coming!" — a later tale.

after.ja: 合肥は呉の北上を阻む壁であり続け、[[p:孫権]]はこの後も何度も攻めて落とせなかった。
after.en: Hefei remained the wall against Wu's advance north; [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]] attacked it again and again and never took it.

deploy.ja: 漢中を争って、[[p:劉備]]は陽平関から定軍山へ陣を移した。[[p:夏侯淵]]と[[p:張郃]]が山の下に陣を敷いた。
deploy.en: Fighting for Hanzhong, [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] moved his camp from Yangping pass up onto Mount Dingjun; [[p:夏侯淵|Xiahou Yuan]] and [[p:張郃|Zhang He]] camped below.

plan.ja: [[p:劉備]]は夜、[[p:夏侯淵]]の陣の柵 (鹿角) に火を放った。夏侯淵が自ら兵を割いて柵を直しに出たところを、[[p:法正]]の「今こそ撃つべし」の言葉で[[p:黄忠]]が山上から太鼓を鳴らして駆け下り、夏侯淵を斬った。
plan.en: At night [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] set fire to the stakes around [[p:夏侯淵|Xiahou Yuan]]'s camp. When Xiahou Yuan went out himself with part of his men to mend them, [[p:法正|Fa Zheng]] said: now. [[p:黄忠|Huang Zhong]] charged down the mountain to the sound of drums and killed him.

tales.ja: [[p:曹操]]はかねて[[p:夏侯淵]]に「将には臆病なときもなければならない。勇気だけに頼るな」と戒めていた。
tales.en: [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] had warned [[p:夏侯淵|Xiahou Yuan]]: "A general must sometimes be timid; do not trust in courage alone."

tales.ja: 漢中に来た[[p:曹操]]は「鶏肋 (鶏の肋骨) だ」とだけ言った。捨てるには惜しいが食べるところがない。楊修はそれを聞いて撤退を悟り、荷造りを始めた。
tales.en: In Hanzhong [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] would say only: "Chicken ribs." Too good to throw away, nothing to eat. Yang Xiu understood that they would retreat, and began to pack.

after.ja: [[p:曹操]]は漢中を捨て、[[p:劉備]]は漢中王を称した。蜀の勢いはここで頂点に達する。
after.en: [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] gave up Hanzhong and [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] named himself King of Hanzhong — the high point of Shu's fortunes.

deploy.ja: [[p:関羽]]の仇を討とうと[[p:劉備]]は呉に攻め込み、長江沿いの山あい数百里に四十余りの陣を連ねた。呉は若い[[p:陸遜]]を大都督に任じた。
deploy.en: To avenge [[p:関羽|Guan Yu]] [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] invaded Wu and strung more than forty camps along hundreds of li of the Yangzi gorges. Wu made the young [[p:陸遜|Lu Xun]] its commander-in-chief.

plan.ja: [[p:陸遜]]は戦わず、老将たちの不満を抑えて半年以上守り続けた。夏の暑さで蜀軍が林の中に陣を移し、疲れが見えたとき、陸遜は兵に茅を一束ずつ持たせて火を放ち、四十余りの陣を一気に焼き払った。
plan.en: [[p:陸遜|Lu Xun]] would not fight, and held for more than half a year against the grumbling of older generals. When the summer heat drove the Shu army into the woods and it began to tire, he had each man carry a bundle of reeds, set fire to the camps and burned forty of them at a stroke.

tales.ja: 白帝城に逃れた[[p:劉備]]は、死の床で[[p:諸葛亮]]に「子 ([[p:劉禅]]) が補佐するに足りなければ、君が自ら取れ」と告げた。諸葛亮は涙を流して、死ぬまで忠を尽くすと誓った。
tales.en: Fled to Baidi, [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] on his deathbed told [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]]: "If my son is worth helping, help him; if not, take the throne yourself." Weeping, Zhuge Liang swore to serve to his death.

tales.ja: 退路を断たれた[[p:黄権]]は、呉ではなく魏に降った。[[p:劉備]]は「わたしが黄権を裏切ったのであって、黄権がわたしを裏切ったのではない」と言い、その家族を罪に問わなかった。
tales.en: Cut off, [[p:黄権|Huang Quan]] surrendered — to Wei, not Wu. [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] said: "I failed Huang Quan; he did not fail me," and left his family unharmed.

after.ja: [[p:劉備]]は翌年白帝城で世を去り、蜀は[[p:諸葛亮]]のもとで呉と和を結び直した。
after.en: [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] died at Baidi the next year; under [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]] Shu made peace with Wu again.

deploy.ja: 反[[p:董卓]]の連合軍のうち、ただ一人まともに戦ったのが長沙太守の[[p:孫堅]]であった。孫堅は陽人に陣を進め、董卓は胡軫・[[p:呂布]]・華雄らを差し向けた。
deploy.en: Of the allied lords against [[p:董卓|Dong Zhuo]], only [[p:孫堅|Sun Jian]] of Changsha truly fought. He advanced to Yangren, and Dong Zhuo sent Hu Zhen, [[p:呂布|Lü Bu]] and Hua Xiong against him.

plan.ja: [[p:董卓]]軍の将たちは互いに仲が悪く、夜に[[p:孫堅]]の陣を襲おうとして足並みが乱れた。孫堅はその乱れを突いて大いに破り、華雄を斬った。
plan.en: [[p:董卓|Dong Zhuo]]'s generals were at odds; their night attack fell into confusion, and [[p:孫堅|Sun Jian]] struck into the disorder, routed them and beheaded Hua Xiong.

after.ja: [[p:孫堅]]は洛陽に入り、[[p:董卓]]が荒らした陵墓を修めた。焼け跡の井戸から伝国の玉璽を得たとも伝わる。
after.en: [[p:孫堅|Sun Jian]] entered Luoyang and restored the tombs [[p:董卓|Dong Zhuo]] had plundered; in a well among the ruins, it is said, he found the imperial seal.

deploy.ja: [[p:公孫瓚]]は歩兵三万を方陣に組み、両翼に騎兵を置き、白馬に乗った精鋭「白馬義従」を中央に構えた。[[p:袁紹]]は麴義に精兵八百と強弩千張を先鋒として与えた。
deploy.en: [[p:公孫瓚|Gongsun Zan]] drew up thirty thousand foot in a square with horse on both wings and his white-horse guard in the centre. [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]] gave Qu Yi eight hundred picked men and a thousand strong crossbows as his van.

plan.ja: 麴義の兵は盾の陰に伏せて動かず、白馬義従が数十歩まで迫ったところで一斉に立ち上がり、弩を放って斬り込んだ。騎兵は総崩れとなり、[[p:公孫瓚]]の陣は破れた。
plan.en: Qu Yi's men lay still behind their shields until the white horses were a few dozen paces off, then rose as one, loosed their crossbows and charged. The cavalry broke, and with it [[p:公孫瓚|Gongsun Zan]]'s army.

after.ja: [[p:公孫瓚]]は北へ退き、[[p:袁紹]]は冀州を固めた。
after.en: [[p:公孫瓚|Gongsun Zan]] fell back north, and [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]] held Ji firmly.

deploy.ja: 宛の張繡は一度は[[p:曹操]]に降った。ところが曹操が張繡の叔父の未亡人を側に置いたため、張繡は恨みを抱き、[[p:賈詡]]の策で夜襲をかけた。
deploy.en: Zhang Xiu of Wan had surrendered to [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]]; but Cao took Zhang Xiu's widowed aunt for himself, and Zhang Xiu, nursing his anger, attacked by night on [[p:賈詡|Jia Xu]]'s plan.

plan.ja: 不意を突かれた[[p:曹操]]の陣は崩れ、[[p:典韋]]は門を守って一人で戦い、全身に傷を負って死んだ。長子曹昂は自分の馬を父に譲って討たれ、甥の曹安民も死んだ。
plan.en: Cao's camp, taken by surprise, collapsed. [[p:典韋|Dian Wei]] held the gate alone until he died of his wounds; Cao's eldest son Cao Ang gave his father his own horse and was killed, and his nephew Cao Anmin with him.

after.ja: [[p:曹操]]はのちに「子を失ったより[[p:典韋]]を失ったことが悲しい」と言ったという。張繡は二年後、[[p:賈詡]]の勧めで曹操に降った。
after.en: Cao later said he grieved more for [[p:典韋|Dian Wei]] than for his son. Two years on Zhang Xiu, on [[p:賈詡|Jia Xu]]'s advice, went over to him.

deploy.ja: [[p:袁紹]]は[[p:顔良]]に白馬を囲ませた。[[p:曹操]]は[[p:荀攸]]の策で西の延津へ向かうと見せかけ、袁紹の兵を西へ引きつけた。
deploy.en: [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]] set [[p:顔良|Yan Liang]] to besiege Baima. On [[p:荀攸|Xun You]]'s plan Cao made as if to cross at Yanjin in the west, drawing Yuan's men that way.

plan.ja: その隙に[[p:曹操]]は軽騎で白馬へ急行した。[[p:張遼]]と[[p:関羽]]が先鋒となり、関羽は[[p:顔良]]の旗印を見つけると馬を走らせて刺し、首を取って戻った。[[p:袁紹]]軍に当たる者はなかった。続いて延津で[[p:文醜]]も討たれた。
plan.en: Meanwhile Cao rode hard for Baima with light horse, [[p:張遼|Zhang Liao]] and [[p:関羽|Guan Yu]] in the van. Guan Yu saw [[p:顔良|Yan Liang]]'s banner, rode at him, struck him down and came back with his head; no one in Yuan's army could stop him. [[p:文醜|Wen Chou]] fell soon after at Yanjin.

after.ja: [[p:袁紹]]は二人の猛将を失って士気が落ちたが、なお大軍で官渡へ迫った。
after.en: [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]], his two champions lost, saw his army's spirits sink — yet still pressed on to Guandu with a great host.

deploy.ja: [[p:馬超]]・[[p:韓遂]]ら関西の軍閥十万が潼関に集まった。[[p:曹操]]は正面で睨み合いながら、[[p:徐晃]]らを北から黄河を渡らせて背後に回らせた。
deploy.en: A hundred thousand men of the western warlords under [[p:馬超|Ma Chao]] and [[p:韓遂|Han Sui]] massed at Tongguan. Cao held them in front while [[p:徐晃|Xu Huang]] and others crossed the Yellow River to the north and got behind them.

plan.ja: [[p:曹操]]は[[p:賈詡]]の策で、[[p:韓遂]]と馬上で親しげに昔話をし、さらに要所を墨で塗りつぶした手紙を韓遂に送った。[[p:馬超]]は韓遂を疑い、関西の軍は内輪もめを起こしたところを討たれた。
plan.en: On [[p:賈詡|Jia Xu]]'s plan Cao chatted with [[p:韓遂|Han Sui]] on horseback about old times, then sent him a letter with key words inked out. [[p:馬超|Ma Chao]] came to suspect Han Sui; the western armies fell out among themselves, and were struck down.

after.ja: [[p:馬超]]と[[p:韓遂]]は涼州へ逃れ、関中は[[p:曹操]]のものとなった。
after.en: [[p:馬超|Ma Chao]] and [[p:韓遂|Han Sui]] fled to Liang, and the land within the passes was Cao's.

deploy.ja: [[p:関羽]]は荊州から北上して樊城の[[p:曹仁]]を囲み、魏は[[p:于禁]]に七軍を与えて救援に送った。[[p:龐徳]]は棺を担がせて出陣し、死を覚悟して関羽と戦った。
deploy.en: [[p:関羽|Guan Yu]] marched north from Jing and besieged [[p:曹仁|Cao Ren]] in Fancheng; Wei sent [[p:于禁|Yu Jin]] with seven armies to the rescue. [[p:龐徳|Pang De]] went out with his coffin carried behind him, ready to die fighting Guan Yu.

plan.ja: 秋の長雨で漢水があふれ、低地に陣を張っていた[[p:于禁]]の七軍は水に沈んだ。[[p:関羽]]は船で攻め寄せ、于禁は降り、[[p:龐徳]]は降らずに斬られた。
plan.en: The autumn rains flooded the Han, and [[p:于禁|Yu Jin]]'s seven armies, camped on the low ground, were drowned out. [[p:関羽|Guan Yu]] came at them by boat; Yu Jin surrendered, and [[p:龐徳|Pang De]], who would not, was beheaded.

after.ja: [[p:関羽]]の威名は中原を震わせ、[[p:曹操]]は都を移すことさえ考えた。だがその背後で、[[p:孫権]]の[[p:呂蒙]]が荊州を襲った。
after.en: [[p:関羽|Guan Yu]]'s name shook the central plain, and Cao even thought of moving his capital. But behind him, [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]]'s [[p:呂蒙|Lü Meng]] fell on Jing.

deploy.ja: [[p:諸葛亮]]は要の街亭を、老将たちを差し置いて若い[[p:馬謖]]に任せた。命じたのは「水のある道を押さえよ」であった。
deploy.en: [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]] gave the key post of Jieting to young [[p:馬謖|Ma Su]] over the veteran generals, with orders to hold the road where the water was.

plan.ja: [[p:馬謖]]は命に背いて山の上に陣を張った。魏の[[p:張郃]]は水の手を断って山を囲み、渇いた蜀軍は崩れた。王平だけが兵をまとめて退いた。
plan.en: [[p:馬謖|Ma Su]] disobeyed and camped on the hilltop. Wei's [[p:張郃|Zhang He]] cut him off from the water and surrounded the hill; the thirsting Shu army broke. Only Wang Ping kept his men together.

after.ja: [[p:諸葛亮]]は泣いて[[p:馬謖]]を斬り、自らも位を三等下げた。
after.en: [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]], weeping, had [[p:馬謖|Ma Su]] beheaded, and lowered his own rank three grades.

deploy.ja: 呉の周魴は髪を切って偽りの降伏を示し、魏の曹休を深く誘い込んだ。[[p:孫権]]は[[p:陸遜]]を大都督とし、朱桓・全琮を左右に置いた。
deploy.en: Zhou Fang of Wu cut off his hair to prove a false surrender and lured Cao Xiu of Wei deep in. [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]] made [[p:陸遜|Lu Xun]] grand commander, with Zhu Huan and Quan Cong on either wing.

plan.ja: 欺かれたと知っても引かなかった曹休を、[[p:陸遜]]は正面から、朱桓・全琮が左右から攻め、魏軍は夾石まで追い崩された。
plan.en: Cao Xiu, though he knew he had been tricked, would not withdraw; [[p:陸遜|Lu Xun]] struck him in front while Zhu Huan and Quan Cong came in from the flanks, and the Wei army was chased back in rout to Jiashi.

after.ja: 曹休は恥じて背中に悪性の腫れ物ができ、まもなく死んだ。
after.en: Cao Xiu, ashamed, broke out in a carbuncle on his back and soon died.

deploy.ja: [[p:孫権]]の死に乗じて、魏は東興の堤を壊そうと大軍で攻め寄せた。呉の諸葛恪が四万で救援に向かい、[[p:丁奉]]が先鋒に立った。
deploy.en: On [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]]'s death Wei came in force to break the dyke at Dongxing. Zhuge Ke of Wu went to its relief with forty thousand, [[p:丁奉|Ding Feng]] in the van.

plan.ja: 大雪の日、魏の将たちは酒を飲んで油断していた。[[p:丁奉]]は兵に鎧を脱がせ、兜と短い刀だけで堤を駆け上がらせた。魏の陣は崩れ、逃げる兵で浮橋が落ちた。
plan.en: It was a day of heavy snow and the Wei officers were drinking. [[p:丁奉|Ding Feng]] had his men strip off their armour and run up the dyke with helmets and short swords only. The Wei camp broke, and the pontoon bridge gave way under the fleeing men.

after.ja: 諸葛恪の名は大いに上がったが、驕った諸葛恪は翌年の合肥新城で大敗し、殺される。
after.en: Zhuge Ke's name soared — and, grown proud, he was beaten at the new city of Hefei the next year and killed.

deploy.ja: [[p:姜維]]は鎮西大将軍胡済と上邽で落ち合う約束で出陣したが、胡済は来なかった。魏の[[p:鄧艾]]は姜維の動きを読み、段谷で待ち構えた。
deploy.en: [[p:姜維|Jiang Wei]] set out to meet Hu Ji at Shanggui, but Hu Ji never came. [[p:鄧艾|Deng Ai]] of Wei read his moves and waited for him at Duangu.

plan.ja: 孤立した[[p:姜維]]の軍は[[p:鄧艾]]に撃ち破られ、四散した。
plan.en: [[p:姜維|Jiang Wei]]'s army, alone, was broken by [[p:鄧艾|Deng Ai]] and scattered.

after.ja: [[p:姜維]]は罪を請うて位を下げられた。蜀の国力はますます衰えた。
after.en: [[p:姜維|Jiang Wei]] asked to be punished and was lowered in rank; Shu grew weaker still.

deploy.ja: [[p:姜維]]が剣閣で[[p:鍾会]]の大軍を防いでいる間に、[[p:鄧艾]]は陰平から人の通わぬ山道を越えて蜀の奥へ出た。諸葛瞻 ([[p:諸葛亮]]の子) が綿竹で迎え撃った。
deploy.en: While [[p:姜維|Jiang Wei]] held [[p:鍾会|Zhong Hui]]'s great army at Jiange, [[p:鄧艾|Deng Ai]] crossed the trackless mountains from Yinping into the heart of Shu. Zhuge Zhan, son of [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]], met him at Mianzhu.

plan.ja: [[p:鄧艾]]は「琅邪王にしよう」と降伏を誘ったが、諸葛瞻は使者を斬った。激戦の末、諸葛瞻とその子諸葛尚は戦死した。
plan.en: [[p:鄧艾|Deng Ai]] offered to make him Prince of Langya if he surrendered; Zhuge Zhan beheaded the envoy. After hard fighting Zhuge Zhan and his son Zhuge Shang fell.

after.ja: 成都は目の前となり、[[p:劉禅]]は降伏を決めた。
after.en: Chengdu lay open, and [[p:劉禅|Liu Shan]] decided to surrender.

name.en: Sun Jian's war on Dong Zhuo

terms.ja: [[p:孫堅]]は洛陽に入り、[[p:董卓]]は長安へ退いた。
terms.en: [[p:孫堅|Sun Jian]] entered Luoyang; [[p:董卓|Dong Zhuo]] fell back to Chang'an.

terms.ja: 留守の兗州を張邈と[[p:陳宮]]が[[p:呂布]]に明け渡したため、[[p:曹操]]は兵を返した。
terms.en: Zhang Miao and [[p:陳宮|Chen Gong]] handed [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]]'s home province of Yan to [[p:呂布|Lü Bu]] behind his back, and Cao Cao turned for home.

name.en: the war of Yuan Shao and Gongsun Zan

terms.ja: 易京の楼に籠もった[[p:公孫瓚]]は、地下道を掘られて楼を崩され、妻子を殺して自ら火の中に身を投じた。河北は[[p:袁紹]]のものとなった。
terms.en: Holed up in the towers of Yijing, [[p:公孫瓚|Gongsun Zan]] saw them undermined and brought down; he killed his wife and children and threw himself into the fire. The north was [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]]'s.

name.en: Cao Cao's war on Zhang Xiu

terms.ja: 張繡は[[p:賈詡]]の勧めで[[p:曹操]]に降った。
terms.en: Zhang Xiu, on [[p:賈詡|Jia Xu]]'s advice, went over to [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]].

name.en: the war of Cao Cao and Yuan Shao

terms.ja: [[p:袁尚]]・袁熙は遼東の公孫康のもとへ逃れたが斬られ、その首が[[p:曹操]]に届けられた。袁氏は滅んだ。
terms.en: [[p:袁尚|Yuan Shang]] and Yuan Xi fled to Gongsun Kang in Liaodong, who cut off their heads and sent them to [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]]. The Yuan were finished.

terms.ja: 一年余りの攻防の末、[[p:曹仁]]は江陵を捨てて北へ退いた。[[p:周瑜]]は南郡太守となったが、翌年蜀を取る計画の途中で病没する。
terms.en: After more than a year of fighting [[p:曹仁|Cao Ren]] abandoned Jiangling and withdrew north. [[p:周瑜|Zhou Yu]] became governor of Nan commandery — and died of illness the next year, in the midst of planning to take Shu.

terms.ja: [[p:馬超]]と[[p:韓遂]]は涼州へ逃れ、関中は[[p:曹操]]のものとなった。
terms.en: [[p:馬超|Ma Chao]] and [[p:韓遂|Han Sui]] fled to Liang, and the land within the passes was Cao's.

terms.ja: 疫病も広がり、[[p:孫権]]は兵を引いた。
terms.en: With plague spreading too, [[p:孫権|Sun Quan]] withdrew.

terms.ja: [[p:曹操]]は「鶏肋」と言って漢中を捨て、長安へ退いた。[[p:劉備]]は漢中王を称した。
terms.en: Saying "chicken ribs", [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] gave up Hanzhong and fell back to Chang'an. [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] named himself King of Hanzhong.

terms.ja: [[p:呂蒙]]が荊州を襲い、[[p:関羽]]は臨沮で捕らえられて斬られた。
terms.en: [[p:呂蒙|Lü Meng]] fell on Jing; [[p:関羽|Guan Yu]] was taken at Linju and beheaded.

terms.ja: [[p:劉備]]は白帝城に退いた。翌年、劉備の死の後、鄧芝が呉へ使いし、蜀と呉は再び同盟を結んだ。
terms.en: [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] withdrew to Baidi. The next year, after his death, Deng Zhi went to Wu and Shu and Wu were allies once more.

terms.ja: 蜀軍は漢中へ退き、離反した三郡は魏に戻った。
terms.en: The Shu army fell back to Hanzhong, and the three commanderies that had rebelled were Wei's again.

terms.ja: 曹休は大敗して逃れ、まもなく死んだ。
terms.en: Cao Xiu fled in rout and soon died.

terms.ja: 魏軍は退き、諸葛恪の名が上がった。
terms.en: The Wei army withdrew, and Zhuge Ke's name rose.

terms.ja: [[p:姜維]]は大敗して退き、位を下げられた。
terms.en: [[p:姜維|Jiang Wei]] fell back beaten and was lowered in rank.
[[p:劉禅|Liu Shan]] surrendered, and Shu was no more.

body.ja:
192年、青州 (山東) の黄巾の残党の大集団が兗州に流れ込み、兗州刺史の劉岱を殺した。[[p:曹操]]は迎え撃ち、追い詰めて冬までに降伏させた。降った兵は三十万余り、男女百万余りと伝わる。

曹操はその中から精鋭を選んで「青州兵」と名付け、自分の軍の中核とした。家族ごと降った彼らに土地を与えて住まわせたことが、のちの屯田の先駆けになったとも言われる。

青州兵は曹操がまだ小さな勢力だった頃の柱であった。一方で、もとは流民の集団で規律は荒く、宛城で張繍に敗れたときには味方の村を略奪して、[[p:于禁]]に討たれている。于禁は、陣を固めるのが先と、陣を整えてから曹操に報告し、「古の名将にも劣らない」と褒められた。

曹操が死ぬと、青州兵は太鼓を打ち鳴らして勝手に故郷へ帰ってしまった。一人の主君に結びついた兵であったことを物語る話である。
body.en:
In 192 a huge band of Yellow Turban survivors from Qing (Shandong) poured into Yan province and killed its governor, Liu Dai. [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] met them, hounded them and by winter had them surrender — more than three hundred thousand fighting men and a million men and women in all, it is said.

Cao Cao chose the best of them, called them his "Qingzhou army" and made them the core of his forces. Settling them on the land with their families may have been the forerunner of his military farm colonies.

They were the backbone of Cao Cao's early years — but they were refugees at heart and poorly disciplined. When Cao Cao was beaten at Wan by Zhang Xiu they plundered friendly villages and were attacked for it by [[p:于禁|Yu Jin]], who fortified his camp before reporting to Cao Cao and was praised as the equal of the great generals of old.

When Cao Cao died the Qingzhou men beat their drums and simply went home — soldiers bound to one master.

body.ja:
[[p:曹操]]の親衛の精鋭騎兵。曹氏一族の曹純が率いた。百人隊の長にさえ、ほかの部隊なら将になれる者を選んだと伝わる。

205年、南皮で袁譚を討ったとき、曹純の虎豹騎が袁譚の首を取った。207年の白狼山の戦いでは、烏桓の単于蹋頓を捕らえた。208年、荊州で[[p:劉備]]を追った曹操は、虎豹騎を含む軽騎五千で一昼夜に三百里余りを駆け、長坂で劉備の軍を散らした。劉備は妻子を捨てて逃げ、[[p:趙雲]]が幼い[[p:劉禅]]を抱いて守った。

曹純が死ぬと、曹操は「あれほどの者がまた得られようか」と言って後任を置かず、自ら虎豹騎を率いたという。のちには曹休・[[p:曹真]]ら一族の若い将が率いた。
body.en:
[[p:曹操|Cao Cao]]'s elite guard cavalry, led by his kinsman Cao Chun. Even its captains of a hundred, it was said, were men who could have been generals elsewhere.

In 205 at Nanpi Cao Chun's riders took Yuan Tan's head; in 207 at White Wolf Mountain they captured the Wuhuan chieftain Tadun. In 208, pursuing [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] through Jing, Cao Cao rode with five thousand light horse, the Tiger and Leopard among them, more than three hundred li in a day and a night and scattered Liu Bei's army at Changban. Liu Bei fled, leaving his wife and children; [[p:趙雲|Zhao Yun]] saved the infant [[p:劉禅|Liu Shan]].

When Cao Chun died, Cao Cao said, "Where would I find his like again?" and named no successor, leading the corps himself. Later young men of the clan — Cao Xiu, [[p:曹真|Cao Zhen]] — commanded it.

body.ja:
幽州の[[p:公孫瓚]]が率いた騎兵。白い馬に乗った騎射の精鋭で、公孫瓚自身も白馬に乗った。北方の烏桓は「白馬の長史を避けよ」と言い合い、公孫瓚の姿を描いた的を射て、当てた者を讃えたという。

「義従」とは、義によって従う者の意。公孫瓚は弓の上手な者を集め、兄弟の契りを結んで左右の翼としたとされる。

191年の界橋の戦いで、公孫瓚は歩兵を中央に、左右に騎兵を置いて[[p:袁紹]]に挑んだ。袁紹の先鋒の麴義は、八百の兵を盾の陰に伏せさせ、千張の強弩を左右に置いた。騎兵が数十歩まで迫ったところで一斉に立ち上がって射かけると、白馬の騎兵は崩れた。

この敗北から公孫瓚の運は傾き、易京に籠もった末に滅んだ。若い[[p:趙雲]]は公孫瓚のもとにいて、そこで[[p:劉備]]と出会っている。
body.en:
The horsemen of [[p:公孫瓚|Gongsun Zan]] of You province: picked mounted archers on white horses, with Gongsun Zan himself on a white horse at their head. The Wuhuan of the north warned each other to "keep clear of the officer on the white horse", and shot at targets painted with his likeness, cheering whoever hit it.

"Volunteers" — men who follow out of loyalty: Gongsun Zan gathered the best archers, swore brotherhood with them and made them his two wings.

At Jieqiao in 191 he challenged [[p:袁紹|Yuan Shao]] with infantry in the centre and horse on both wings. Yuan Shao's vanguard commander Qu Yi had eight hundred men crouch behind their shields, with a thousand strong crossbows on either side; when the horsemen were a few dozen paces away they rose and shot together, and the white horses broke.

From that defeat Gongsun Zan's fortunes declined, until he died shut up in Yijing. The young [[p:趙雲|Zhao Yun]] served him, and met [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] there.

body.ja:
[[p:呂布]]の将、[[p:高順]]が率いた精兵。七百ほどの兵だったが、鎧や兜、武具はすべて精巧に整えられ、攻めかかった陣はどれも必ず破った。それで「陥陣営」(陣を陥とす隊) と呼ばれた。

高順は清廉で威厳があり、酒を飲まず、贈り物も受け取らなかった。呂布に何度も忠告したが、呂布はその忠義を知りながら用いきれず、兵を取り上げて魏続に与え、戦いのときだけ返したという。高順はそれでも恨むことがなかった。

198年、高順は小沛の[[p:劉備]]を破り、救援に来た[[p:夏侯惇]]も退けた。しかし同じ年、[[p:曹操]]に下邳を囲まれて呂布とともに捕らえられ、斬られた。
body.en:
The picked men of [[p:高順|Gao Shun]], [[p:呂布|Lü Bu]]'s general — only seven hundred or so, but every piece of their armour and gear was finely made and kept, and no formation they attacked held. They were called the "Formation Breakers".

Gao Shun was upright and stern; he did not drink and accepted no gifts. He warned Lü Bu again and again, and Lü Bu, knowing his loyalty, still could not make use of him — he took Gao Shun's men away, gave them to Wei Xu, and handed them back only for battle. Gao Shun bore no grudge.

In 198 Gao Shun beat [[p:劉備|Liu Bei]] at Xiaopei and drove off [[p:夏侯惇|Xiahou Dun]], who came to Liu Bei's aid. That same year [[p:曹操|Cao Cao]] besieged Xiapi; Gao Shun was taken with Lü Bu and beheaded.

body.ja:
蜀の南中 (今の雲南・貴州あたり) の民から選んだ部隊。225年に[[p:諸葛亮]]が南中を平らげたのち、勇猛な青羌の兵一万余家を蜀へ移して五部に分けた。向かうところ前に立つ者がない「飛軍」と呼ばれた。「無当」は、当たる敵なし、の意とされる。

山の戦いに強かったという。228年、街亭で[[p:馬謖]]が山上に陣を敷いて[[p:張郃]]に敗れたとき、王平だけが太鼓を鳴らして陣を保ち、張郃に伏兵を疑わせて退かせ、散った兵を集めて帰った。この功で王平は五部を統べることになる。

244年、魏の曹爽が十万余りで漢中に攻め込んだとき (興勢の戦い)、王平は興勢山に兵を張り巡らせ、援軍が来るまで魏軍を防ぎきった。曹爽は多くの牛馬を失って退いた。
body.en:
A corps drawn from the peoples of Nanzhong in the south of Shu (today's Yunnan and Guizhou). After [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]] subdued Nanzhong in 225, more than ten thousand households of fierce Qiang warriors were moved into Shu and formed into five divisions, the "Flying Army", before whom no one could stand; "Wudang" is read as "none can withstand".

They were strong in mountain warfare. In 228 at Jieting, when [[p:馬謖|Ma Su]] camped on a hill and was beaten by [[p:張郃|Zhang He]], only Wang Ping kept his drums beating and his ranks together, so that Zhang He feared an ambush and drew back; Wang Ping gathered the scattered men and brought them home, and for this was given command of the five divisions.

In 244 the Wei regent Cao Shuang invaded Hanzhong with over a hundred thousand men. Wang Ping spread his troops along Mount Xingshi and held until help came; Cao Shuang retreated, having lost most of his oxen and horses.

body.ja:
[[p:諸葛亮]]は、それまでの連弩を改良した「元戎」を作ったと伝わる。長さ八寸の鉄の矢を、一つの弩から十本同時に放てたという。

諸葛亮は兵器と輸送の工夫でも知られる。険しい山道で兵糧を運んだ「木牛」と「流馬」、陣の組み方の「八陣図」も彼の工夫とされる。秦嶺の山々を越える北伐の軍は、いつも兵糧を前線へ運ぶことに苦しんだ。

連弩の実物は残っておらず、後の書物にさまざまな復元図が描かれた。明の時代には、箱に入れた矢をてこで次々に放つ「諸葛弩」と呼ばれる連発の弩が使われ、今でも中国の歴史ドラマでおなじみである。
body.en:
[[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]] is said to have improved the repeating crossbow into the "Yuanrong", which shot ten iron bolts, each eight inches long, at once.

He is remembered for his engineering too: the "wooden ox" and "gliding horse" that carried grain over mountain paths, and the "eight formations" for drawing up an army. His northern campaigns, over the Qinling mountains, always struggled to bring food to the front.

No example survives, and later books drew many reconstructions. In the Ming a magazine-fed crossbow worked with a lever, the "Zhuge crossbow", was in use; it is a familiar sight in Chinese historical dramas.

body.ja:
蜀 (四川) の都成都は、錦 (色糸で模様を織り出した厚い絹) の名産地で、「錦官城」とも呼ばれた。錦を織る役所があったからである。織り上げた錦を川で洗うと色がいっそう鮮やかになると言われ、その川は「錦江」と名付けられた。

山に囲まれ、人も少ない蜀にとって、錦は国を支える財源だった。[[p:諸葛亮]]は「今、民は貧しく国は空っぽだ。敵と決着をつける元手は、ただ錦だけが頼りである」と書いている。蜀の錦は、敵国の魏にも同盟国の呉にも売られ、各国の貴人の衣となった。

263年、魏に降伏したとき、蜀の蔵には錦や絹がそれぞれ二十万匹も残っていたと伝わる。のちの唐の詩人杜甫も、成都の諸葛亮の廟を「錦官城の外、柏の森が深い」と詠んでいる。
body.en:
Chengdu, capital of Shu (Sichuan), was famous for brocade — heavy silk woven with patterns in coloured thread — and was called "the City of the Brocade Office" after the bureau that ran the looms. Washing the cloth in its river was said to brighten the colours, and the river was named the Brocade River.

For a poor, thinly peopled kingdom ringed by mountains, brocade paid the bills. "The people are poor and the state is empty," [[p:諸葛亮|Zhuge Liang]] wrote; "the means to settle with the enemy depend on brocade alone." Shu brocade was sold to Wei, its enemy, and Wu, its ally, alike, and dressed the great of every court.

When Shu surrendered to Wei in 263, its storehouses still held two hundred thousand bolts each of brocade and silk, it is said. Centuries later the Tang poet Du Fu wrote of Zhuge Liang's shrine "outside the City of the Brocade Office, among the dark cypresses".

body.ja:
長江と東の海に面した呉は、船の国であった。川の戦いでは、何層もの櫓を重ねた大きな「楼船」、牛の皮で覆った細長い突撃船「蒙衝」、矢を防ぐ壁を巡らせた「闘艦」が使われた。赤壁で[[p:黄蓋]]が火をつけて突っ込ませたのも、蒙衝と闘艦である。

呉は南の建安郡 (今の福建) の侯官に船を造る役所を置き、罪人も送り込んで大きな船を造らせた。帆を四枚張り、風を斜めに受けても進める船があったと、呉の人万震は書いている。

呉の船は海の向こうへも出た。230年、[[p:孫権]]は将軍衛温と諸葛直に一万の兵を与えて、海の東の夷洲 (台湾とも言われる) を探らせた。多くの兵が病で死んだが、数千人の島の人を連れ帰ったという。同じ頃、朱応と康泰は南の扶南 (今のカンボジアあたり) まで使いに行き、南の国々のことを書き残した。

孫権自身も船を好んだ。「長安」と名付けた大船を造り、嵐の中で武昌の釣台へ向かわせようとして、家臣に止められたという話が残っている。
body.en:
Wu, on the Yangzi and the eastern sea, was a nation of ships. On the river it fought with "tower ships" built up in storeys, long narrow assault boats sheathed in oxhide, and "fighting ships" walled against arrows; at Red Cliffs [[p:黄蓋|Huang Gai]]'s fire boats were assault boats and fighting ships.

Wu set up a shipbuilding office at Houguan in the far southern commandery of Jian'an (today's Fujian), sending convicts to build great hulls there. Some ships carried four sails and could sail with the wind on the beam, wrote Wan Zhen of Wu.
